text.body:
Ṣaṭsāhasrikā-hevajra-ṭīkā
[Fol. 1b] oṃ namaḥ śrīhevajrāya
1 <>
lokācāravivarjitaṃ jinamayaṃ nityoditaṃ vyāpinam | nirdvandvaṃ vimalaṃ nirindriyasukhaṃ sarvajñamevaṃ paraṃ ||
śāntaṃ cittamacittamajaḍaṃ sarvendriyaṃ sarvato | buddhānāṃ praṇipatya kāyamamṛtaṃ svābhāvikaṃ bodhaye || 1 ||
pradhvastāṣṭaguṇodbhavātti vadanānyaṣṭau vimokṣā vibhor | hastāḥ ṣoḍaśaśūnyatāśca karuṇā etāḥ kapālāni ca ||
paṃcāśatakṣaravarṇatattvaracitā skandhe śiromālikā | akṣobhyo mukuṭe'rdhacandrakuliśaṃ mālākapālātmikā || 2 ||
maitryādyāśca vimokṣakāḥ sucaraṇāḥ saṃpīḍya mārān sthitāḥ | kleśajñeyasamājayogaüragā mudrājinaṃ dīpinaḥ ||
mārādyāvaraṇāni yasya lavavat sattvārthamābhūṣaṇam | taṃ natvāsya ca tantraguhyagadikā ṭīkā mayā likhyate || 3 ||
śrīmatā vajragarbheṇa sarvasattvahitaiṣiṇā | daśabhūmīśvareṇeyaṃ mārgalābhāya yoginām || 4 ||
paṃcalakṣātmahātantrādalpatantre samuddhṛte | sārdhasaptaśate'pyasmin bahuvajrapadānvite || 5 ||
hevajracoditenaiṣā yā ṣaṭsāhasrikā matā | seyaṃ tantraprakāśārthaṃ mūlatantrānusāriṇī || 6 ||
ācāryā ye bhaviṣyanti yogācārasya deśakāḥ | kāle paṃcakaṣāye'sminna sanmārgapravartakāḥ || 7 ||
ṭīkāṃ vinālpatantrāṇi deśayiṣyanti durnnayāḥ | parastrīdravyalobhena narake gamanotsukāḥ || 8 ||
kecid ṭīkāṃ kariṣyanti paṃcābhijñādibhirvinā | tarkaśāstrābhimānena yogācāraviḍaṃbakāḥ || 9 ||
buddhatvaṃ vajrasattvatvaṃ sekaiḥ saṃgṛhya yatnataḥ | vayaṃ vajradharāḥ kecid vadiṣyanti narānṛṇām || 10 ||
avandyā bhikṣavaḥ sarve śīlasaṃvaradhāriṇaḥ | sitavastrā vayaṃ vandyāḥ svayaṃ vajradharā bhuvi || 11 ||
sevakāvaṇijaḥ śūdrāḥ kṛṣikarmaratāśca ye | saddharmavikrayā mūrkhā abhogyaparibhoginaḥ || 12 ||
guravaste bhaviṣyanti śiṣyāṇāṃ mārakāyikāḥ | yogācāracchalenaiva gopayitvā svayaṃkṛtān || 13 ||
doṣān doṣaparityāgakaraṇāya vadanti vai | ācāryasya guṇā grāhyā doṣā naiva kadācana || 14 ||
doṣagrahaṇamasiddhirvai śiṣyāṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | niṣkṛpaṃ krodhanaṃ kūraṃ stambhalubdhamasaṃyatam || 15 ||
svotkarṣaṇaṃ ca no kuryāt guruṃ śiṣyaśca buddhimān | idaṃ vākyaṃ na śiṣyāṇāṃ deśayiṣyati sarvathā || 16 ||
niṣkṛpaḥ kṛṣikartā yaḥ krodhano marmabhedakaḥ | krūro bhikṣujanadveṣī stabdhaḥ kujñānagarvitaḥ || 17 ||
lubdho'pyaparibhogārthī atimadyairasaṃyataḥ | svotkarṣaṇaṃ iha prokto guṇināṃ doṣadāyakaḥ || 18 ||
abhiṣekāgralabdho hi vajrācāryastathāgataiḥ | daśadiklokadhātusthaiḥ trikālametyābhivandyate || 19 ||
sandhyābhāṣāmajānanto nāmamātreṇa mohinaḥ | pratikṣepaṃ jinendrāṇāṃ kṛtvā yāsyanti rauravam || 20 ||
bodhimūle'bhiṣikto yo vajrasatvena mastake | abhiṣekāgralabdhaḥ sa vajrācāryastathāgataiḥ || 21 ||
daśadikbodhisatvānāṃ kāyā ye lokadhātavaḥ | tatrasthaiḥ paṃcabhiḥ skandhaiḥ [tri]kālametyābhivandyate || 22 ||
nānāratnamayāsteṣāṃ maulayo lokadhātavaḥ | tatrasthairvandyate buddhairvajrācāryaḥ sa yoginām || 23 ||
śakṛdvairocano mūtraṃ śukraṃ vai samayo yathā | akṣobhyaścāmitābhaśca ācāryo vajradhṛk yathā || 24 ||
viṇmūtraśukramudrāṇāmācāryo dāyako yathā | kāyavākcittasiddhīnāṃ dāyako vajradhṛk tathā || 25 ||
saṃvṛtyāṃ ca vivṛtyāṃ ca śiṣyāṇāṃ yogināmapi | maṇḍale bodhimūle yaḥ sekaḥ pūrvāpareṇa saḥ || 26 ||
saṃdhyābhāṣaṃ yathā'saṃdhyaṃ rutannānyattathā'rutam | nītārthatvaṃ tannaneyantantraṃ ṣaṭkoṭilakṣaṇam || 27 ||
ācāryasya guṇā ye te vyavahāreṇa darśitāḥ | vajrasatvaguṇāstena ṣaḍabhijñādilakṣaṇāḥ || 28 ||
dhīro vinīto matimān kṣamāvānārjavo'śaṭhaḥ | mantratantraprayogajñaḥ kṛpāluḥ śāstrakovidaḥ || 29 ||
daśatattvaparijñātā maṇḍalālekhyakarmavit | mantravyākhyākṛdācāryaḥ prasannātmā jitendriyaḥ || 30 ||
ebhiruktaguṇairyukto bhikṣurvajradharo bhavet | na celuko gṛhī, nātra daśa[kaṃ] bhikṣusamaṃ tathoḥ || 31 ||
daśaśikṣāpadairyuktaḥ paṃcaśikṣāpadairyutaḥ | koṭiśikṣāpadairyukto na te tulyāstraya smṛtāḥ || 32 ||
mūlatantre yathā proktaṃ bhikṣorvajradhara padam | gurvārādhakaśiṣyāṇāṃ tatra kiṃcinnagadyate || 33 ||
nairātmādhyeṣito vajrī yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ | śikṣāpadapradānāya idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 34 ||
paṃcaśikṣāpadānyādau poṣadhādisamanvitam | daśākuśalaparityāgaṃ datvā kuryādupāsakam || 35 ||
śrāmaṇeraṃ tataḥ kuryāddatvā śikṣāpadaṃ daśa | koṭiśikṣāpadaṃ datvā bhikṣuṃ kuryāt tato vratīm || 36 ||
prātimokṣaṃ tato jñātvā vaibhāṣikamataṃ tataḥ | bhūtrāntaṃ ca tato jñātvā vijñānavādaṃ svadharmataḥ || 37 ||
tato madhyamakaṃ jñātvā prajñāpāramitāmatam | sarvatantrāntaraṃ jñātvā hevajraṃ jñāyate tataḥ || 38 ||
yānatritayaniryāta ekayānaphale sthitaḥ | śrāvakaṃ pratyekañcātra mahāyānaṃ tṛtīyakam || 39 ||
caturthaṃ nāsti bodhānāṃ paṃcamañca mataṃ muneḥ | sarvākāravaropetā śūnyatā heturāditaḥ || 40 ||
praṇidhānāt kṛpā paścājjagadarthakariphalam | svārthaṃ kṛtvā parārthaṃ hi kārayedyaḥ sa buddhimān || 41 ||
svayaṃ duḥkhī daridro yaḥ so'nyeṣāṃ dadate katham | sukhamaiśvaryasaṃpatti sattvārthakaruṇodyataḥ || 42 ||
yāvanna kriyate sākṣāt heturhetuphalārthinām | tāvadādau phalaṃ kasmānnirahetorbha[vi]ṣyati || 43 ||
mahāyānāt paraṃ yānaṃ dvitīyamiti kathyate | dānaśīlādinaṣṭānāṃ viśrāmāya na tatvataḥ || 44 ||
śūnyatā sarvadharmāṇāṃ proktā niḥsaraṇaṃ mayā | niḥsaraṇāttato hetoḥ praṇidhānavaśāttataḥ || 45 ||
bhaviṣyati nirālambaṃ karuṇātmakaphalaṃ mahat | sattvadharmanirālambā karuṇā trividhā smṛtā || 46 ||
pradeśe'rthakarī kiṃcit sattvadharmāvalambinī | siddhānāṃ bodhisattvānāṃ daśabhūmau sthitātmanām || 47 ||
dvādaśāṅganiruddhānāṃ sarvabhūmau sthitātmanām | sugatānāṃ nirālambā janadarthakarī smṛtā || 48 ||
yādṛśo yādṛśo hetuḥ tādṛśaṃ tādṛśaṃ phalam | kodravebhyo na jāyante śālayaḥ kecideva hi || 49 ||
yathā bījaṃ tathā vṛkṣo yathā vṛkṣastathā phalam | ādau madhyāvasāne ca kalyāṇaṃ vacanaṃ mama || 50 ||
ādau vikalpakāddhetoḥ savikalpaṃ śūnyatā phalaṃ bhavet | ante ca sarvabauddhānāṃ akalpataḥ śūnyatā phalam || 51 ||
athādau kṣetraśuddhyarthaṃ kodravānāṃ hi vāpanam | paścādviśodhite kṣetre śālidhānyasya vāpanam || 52 ||
nāśuddhaṃ kṣetramityuktaṃ mānuṣaṃ karmabhūmijam | aśuddhaṃ ṣaḍgatau janmaṃ śubhāśubhaphaloditam || 53 ||
manuṣyajanmani kṣetre śuddhe'nāvalāmbini kṛpā- bījaṃ hi vāpitaṃ tasmāt śūnyakalpadrumo bhavet || 54 ||
śūnyatā-kalpavṛkṣāt anālambakṛpāphalam | cintitaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ bhavatīha na saṃśayaḥ || 55 ||
mudrāmaṇḍalamantrādi deśitaṃ yanmayā priye | gambhīrodāradharmeṣu bhavyatāvigatātmanām || 56 ||
mudrāmaṇḍalamantrādyairdeśayiṣyantyanāgatāḥ | buddhatvaṃ vajrasattvatvamācāryā mārakayikā || 57 ||
ato bhikṣurmahāyāne deśako vajradhṛk smṛtaḥ | yānatrayaparijñātā dharmasaṃgrahavedakaḥ || 58 ||
vedasiddhāntayogānāṃ kṛtānāmīśvarādibhiḥ | bauddhānāṃ tantramantrāṇāṃ viśeṣaḥ śūnyatāṃ prati || 59 ||
yo na jānāti mūḍhātmā sa śiṣyān pātayet khilān || 60 ||
karma kartrā vinā nāsti na karmarahitaṃ phalam | mahāmāyā mahāraudrā bhūtasaṃhārakāriṇī || 61 ||
svayaṃ kartā svayaṃ hartā svayaṃ rājā svayaṃ prabhuḥ | īśvarasya tathā māyā īśvaro'pi nigadyate || 62 ||
tīrthīkaiḥ śaivasiddhāntergītādharmme janārdanaḥ | durddāntadamakaḥ so'pi sādhūnāṃ pālakassa ca || 63 ||
yadā yadātra dharmasya glānirbhavati bhārata | adharmasya pravṛttiśca tadātmānaṃ sṛjāmyaham || 64 ||
sādhūnāṃ rakṣaṇāya vināśāya ca duṣkṛtām | dharmmasaṃsthāpanārthāya saṃbhavāmi yuge yuge || 65 ||
evaṃ sarvaṃ parijñāya viparītāṃ dharmadeśanām hevajraścodayantena māṃ ṭīkākaraṇāya vai || 66 ||
natvā kāyavaraṃ trilokasahitaṃ svābhāvikaṃ nirmmalam | dharmmākhyaṃ sukhaduḥkhabhāvarahitaṃ sāmbhogikaṃ deśakam || nirmmāṇañca vicitrakharddhisahitaṃ māyendrajālopamam | dakṣye'haṃ laghutantraguhyavacanaṃ nītārthasyālpataḥ || 67 ||
hevajre jinadeśanātra laghūke sāvisphuṭeyaṃ nṛṇām | lakṣaiḥ paṃcabhirāditantranicaye buddhaiḥ kṛtā yā purā || 68 ||
ślokaire[ka]śataiḥ sahasraguṇitairlakṣābhidhāne'pi vā | anyasminapi tantrarājanicaye ṭīkābhirarthāgamaḥ || 69 ||
yaḥ ṭīkārahite'lpatantranicaye guptaṃ padaṃ deśayet | so'mbunyakṣivivarjitaściragatasyāheḥ padaṃ vīkṣayet || 70 ||
nītārthaṃ na ca neyamarthakhilaṃ tantraṃ jinairdeśitam | neyārthaṃ yadi ṭīkayā prakaṭitaṃ nītaṃ vṛthā bodhaye || 71 ||
saṃdhyābhāṣamasaṃdhyabhāṣaṃmaparaṃ naitadrutaṃ [nā'rutam] | nītārthaṃ na ca neyamarthamakhilaṃ tantraṃ jinairdeśitam || 72 ||
skandhā ye na viḍādayo'tra samalāḥ skandhā na te devatā | sambuddhā na ca devatāmukhabhujaiḥ saṃkalpitā bodhaye || 73 ||
yat ṣaṭkoṭibhirāvṛtaṃ bhagavatā tantraṃ samājādikam | gītaṃ paṇḍitaśāstramānadalanaṃ tad tarkagamyaṃ kutaḥ || 74 ||
ādarśapratisenikāsamamidaṃ traikālyasaṃvedakam | bhāvābhāvavitarkajālarahitaṃ jñānaṃ yadevādvayam || 75 ||
dvātriṃśaddhi mahāsukhe bhagavatā śukrapravāhāḥ smṛtāḥ | nāḍyaḥ kaṇṭhagatāstathaiva hṛdaye nābhau ca guhye ca yāḥ || 76 ||
kiṃvāhāḥ karapādasandhiṣu tathā hastāṅgulīsandhiṣu | hevajre'pi na tā jinena gaditā me vajragarbhasya ca || 77 ||
yaścārṣaṃ pravadanti bhikṣukajanāstanmāgadhaṃ nāparam | vākyaṃ yat piṭakatraye bhagavataḥ tatsthāvarīye mate || 78 ||
rogo'nyo'pi tadanyadauṣadhamidaṃ rogaprahāṇāya vai | arthādyaṃ śaraṇaṃ caturvidhamidaṃ na vyaṃjanādyaṃ munaiḥ || 79 ||
ya devāsuranāgayakṣagaruḍaiḥ anyaiśca saṃdeśikī | dharmāṇāṃ purāya vismayakarī lokopamāvarjitā || 80 ||
seyaṃ saṃskṛtalakṣaṇā bhagavato "pyevaṃ maye"tyādinā | bhāṣārṣaiti nigadyate budhajanairāścaryametatra kim || 81 ||
sarvākāravarendrajālasadṛśo māyopamo vyomagaḥ | kāyo yaḥ sa nigadyate bhagavato bālairviṭairbodhaye || 82 ||
dvātriṃśadbhirindriyaiśañca racitaṃ yallakṣaṇairvyaṃjanaiḥ | skandhairdhātubhirindriyaiśañca viṣayairsārdhaṃ sthito maṇḍale || 83 ||
icchantīha jaḍāḥ pratītyaja-samutpādaṃ hi vettuṃ sadā | nāśotpādatithidhruvādigaṇitāstantrāntare deśitā || 84 ||
keścidbālataro dadhīcchati vinā kṣīreṇa, gobhirvinā | kṣīraṃ gavyamapi pracāra rahito deṣo'tra ko'jñāninaḥ || 85 ||
hevajreṇa hi cakrasaṃvaramidaṃ jñeyaṃ catuḥpīṭhakam | hevajraṃ khalu cakrasaṃvarapadairevaṃ catuṣpīṭhakam || 86 ||
hevajraṃ laghucakrasaṃvaraṃmidaṃ jñeyaṃ catuṣpīṭhakaiḥ | nītārthaṃ paramādibuddhavacanairjñeyaṃ mahāsaṃvaraiḥ || 87 ||
evamanyāni tantrāṇi anyaistantrāṃtaraiḥ sadā | jñeyānyuddeśanirdeśaḥ ṭīkābhirmārgakāṃkṣibhiḥ || 88 ||
iti ṣaṭsāhasrikāyāṃ hevajraṭīkāyāṃ iṣṭadevatāstavaḥ tantrāvatāraḥ prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ |

idānīṃ tantramucyate | iha prathamaṃ tāvadabhidheyābhidhānasaṃbaṃdhaprayojana-prayojanānyabhisaṃvīkṣya vaineyajanānāṃ niyamarahitānāṃ svacittābhiprāyeṇeha janmani buddhatvadāyakaṃ evaṃkārasthitena ḍākinījālaparivṛtena hevajrasamādhisamāpannena vajragarbhādhyeṣitena nairātmya, paripṛcchitena paṃcalakṣahevajrāt sārdhasaptaśatagranthapramāṇaṃ laghutantraṃ bhagavatā saṃdeśitamiti | atrābhidheyo nairātmayā sārdhaṃ hevajra bhagavān | asya pratipādakaṃ paṭalasamūhaṃ tantrarājamabhidhānaṃ tayorabhidheyābhidhānayoḥ parasparavācyavācakalakṣaṇaṃ 'sambandhaḥ' | maṇḍalapraveśādi-abhiṣekadānena 'prayojanam' | śikṣā tattvaprakāśanena 'prayojanaprayojanam' | ityetānyabhisaṃvīkṣya vaineyajanānāṃ niyamarahitānāmiti 'śrāvakasaṃvararahitānām |' 'svacittābhiprāyeṇeti' pañcakāmopabhogacittena | 'iha janmani buddhatvadāyaka'miti punaḥ punarmanuṣyajanmani na devāsurādi[ṣu] 'evaṃkāre sthitene'- ti sarvasaukhyālaye tattvabhāvanayā sthitena | 'ḍākinījālaparivṛtene'ti | skandhadhātvāyatanena lakṣaṇena hevajrasamādhiyuktena vajragarbhādhyeṣitena nairātmyā-prajñā-paripṛcchitena paṃcalakṣahevajrāt mūlatantrāt dvātriṃśat mahākalpāt laghukalpadvayaṃ saṃbodhimāyājālalakṣaṇaṃ dvāviṃśatparicchedātmakaṃ sārdhasaptaśatagranthapramāṇaṃ laghutantraṃ vajrasattvena bhagavatā sandeśitam | laukikalokottarasatyābhyāṃ lokottarasiddhaye utpatti-utpannakramābhyāṃ maṇḍalacakrabhāvanayā tu tattvabhāvanayā ceti | iha tantraṃ hevajravācyaḥ | tantraṃ vācakaṃ hevajrasya | sa ca vācyavācaka svabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | prathamaṃ vajrakulapaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | abhiṣekapaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | tattvapaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | caryāpaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | chomāpīṭhanirṇayapaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | abhisaṃbodhikalparāja yoginīcakramelāpakasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | viśuddhipaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | viśeṣābhibhaṣekapaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | abhisaṃbodhikalparāja-paṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | ityekādaśa paricchedāḥ prathamakalpe | tato māyājāla-kalpe māyā iti ḍākinī jāla iti samūhaḥ | saṃvaro melāpakaḥ herukasārddhamitiniyamaḥ | atraiva prathamaṃ tāvat pratiṣṭhāhomakuṇḍakarmaprasarapūjāpaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ siddhinirṇayapaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | sarvatantranidānasandhyābhāṣāpaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | sarvatantramudraṇapiṇḍārthapaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | hevajrābhyudayapaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | mudrāviśuddhipaṭapustakalikhananiyamapaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | bhojanaviśuddhipaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | padminī lakṣaṇaśiṣyavaineyapaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | devatāviśuddhimantroddhārapaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | mantrajāpapaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | sahajārthayogānujñādinidānapaṭalasvabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | ityevaṃ dvāviṃśat paṭalātmakaṃ tantraṃ svabhāvatayāvasthitaḥ | bhagavān hevajra vajragarbhamāntrayati sma |
* 'tatra bhagavānāha' sarvatathāgatakāyavākcittānāṃ hṛdayaṃ jñānaṃ mahāsukham | tadeva bhaṭṭārakaṃ guhyātiguhyataraṃ vikalpabhāvanāratānāṃ gopyātigopyam |
* aho vajragarbha sādhu sādhu | mahākṛpa vajrasattvasya mahābodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya mahāsamayattvasya hṛdayaṃ hevajrākhyaṃ śṛṇveti |
bhagavato vākyaṃ vijahārasthānāvasāne | ataḥ pūrvaṃ vijahārasthānaṃ bhagavatoktamucyate | paścādbhagavataścodanāvākyaṃ vajragarbhādhyeṣaṇamiti |
* evaṃ mayā śrutamekasmin samaye bhagavān sarvatathāgatakāyavākcittavajrayoṣitbhageṣu vijahāra | iti vijahārapadam |
nanu mayā śrutamevamekasmin samaye iti yadvacanaṃ tad kiṃ deśakasya sarvajñasya āhosvit saṃgītikārakasyādhyeṣakasya | ubhayatāpi doṣo neyārthena | iha yadyatīte kāle śrutaṃ ca tadeva kathayati | tadā bhaviṣyakāle jñānābhāvaḥ parataḥ śruta parijñānāt | atha saṃgītikārakasya tadā evaṃkārāderarthābhāvo vajrasattvenānuktatvāt | tasmādidaṃ vākyaṃ saṃdhyābhāṣantareṇa nītārthenāvagantavyam | asya nītārthaḥ |
ekārākṛtiyaddivyaṃ madhye vaṃkārabhūṣitam | ālayaḥ sarvasaukhyānāṃ buddharatnakaraṇḍakamiti || 1 ||
mahāsukho vajrasattvaḥ | sa evāhaṃ deśakaḥ [mahā]sukhamiti | śrutaṃ jñātam | mayātmanā ekasmin samaye ekakṣaṇābhisaṃbodhau bhagavān mahāsukhaḥ sarvatathāgatāḥ saṃdhyābhāṣayā paṃcaskandhāḥ | teṣāṃ niṣkalaḥ sarvago vyāpī sūkṣmo bījamanāśravaḥ | arajo virajo vimalo vāntadoṣo nirāmayaḥ || 3 ||
suprabuddho vibuddhātmā sarvajñaḥ sarvavitparaḥ | vijñānadharmatātīto jñānamadvayarūpadhṛk || 4 ||
evaṃ sarvāvaraṇa-nirgataścatuḥkāyātmako hevajra bhagavān deśako dvādaśabhūmīśvaraḥ | daśabhūmīśvaro vajragarbha bodhisattvo'dhyeṣakaḥ |
iti ṣaṭsāhasrikāyāṃ hevajraṭīkāyāṃ deśakādhyeṣakābhidhānābhidheyasambandha vijahārasthānaniyamaḥ dvitīyaḥ paricchedaḥ ||

idānīṃ vajragarbhādhyeṣaṇaṃ bhagavataḥ prativacanaṃ vitanyate | vajragarbha āha vajra ityādi |
* vajrasattvo bhavet kena bodhisattvo bhavet katham | mahāsattvo bhavet kasmāt samayasattvaḥ kathaṃ bhavet || 1 ||
ityadhyeṣaṇāṃ vajragarbhasya śrutvā bhagavānāha,
abhedyaṃ vajramityuktaṃ sattvaḥ tribhavasyaikatā | anayā prajñayā yuktyā vajrasattvo iti smṛtaḥ || 2 ||
bodhau vyavasthitaḥ sattvo bodhisattvaḥ sa ucyate | mahājñānarasaiḥ pūrṇo mahāsattvo nigadyate || nityaṃ samayasaṃsthityā samayasattvo'bhidhīyate || 3 ||
ityuddeśasya nirddeśaḥ paṃcalakṣe prakāśitaḥ | tasmāt sa evāvatāryate | tatra bhagavānāha,
abhedyaṃ vajramityuktaṃ ya vaṃkāraḥ prakāśitaḥ | abhedyaṃ kāyavākcittaṃ vaṃkāreṇābhidhīyate || 4 ||
tribhavasyaikatā sattvaṃ ekāreṇābhidhīyate | ekāraḥ prajñayā sārddhaṃ vaṃkārastrikulātmakaḥ || 5 ||
nābhimadhye sthito vīraḥ karṇikāguḍhagocare | sasvābhaprajñayā yukto vajrasattva pragīyate || 6 ||
dvibhujo herukaḥ proktastrailokyākṣepa eva saḥ | svābhāvikaḥ sa evokto buddhakāyo mahāsukhaḥ || 7 ||
jñānavajraṃ tadeva syāt sahajānanda eva saḥ | niṣyando'pi sa evoktaḥ ekasūka parismṛtaḥ || 8 ||
tūryāvasthākṣayaḥ so'pi viśuddha paramākṣaraḥ | bodhau vyavasthito yo'pi hṛt-padme sa vyavathitaḥ || 9 ||
sattvo hūṃkāra evoktaḥ akṣobhyastu sa eva ca | cittavajraḥ sa evoktaḥ viṣṇureva caturbhujaḥ || 10 ||
jvalajvalabhyo sa evokto dharmakāyaḥ sa eva hi | dharmacakre sthito vajrī viramānanda rūpadhṛk || 11 ||
vipāko'pi sa evoktaḥ suṣuptakṣayakārakaḥ || mahājñānarasaiḥ pūrṇo mahāsattvaḥ sa ucyate || 12 ||
kaṇṭhasaṃbhogacakreśo'mitābho'bhidhīyate || vāgvajraḥ sa evoktaḥ padmahastatathāgataḥ || 13 ||
paramānandaḥ sa evoktaḥ puruṣakāraḥ pragīyate | saṃvṛtyā vivṛtyā ca svapnāvasthākṣayaḥ sa ca || 14 ||
sa eva saṃbhogakāya syāt buddhānāṃ dharmadeśakaḥ | sa eva kiṭikiṭivajrastṛtīyo heruko bhavet | nityaṃ samayasaṃsthitā yaḥ sthitaḥ sa nigadyate || 16 ||
samayaṃ śaśabhṛtaṃ śukraṃ lalāṭasthaṃ mahāsukham | amṛte saṃsthitaḥ sattva oṃkāraḥ parigīyate || 17 ||
vairocanaḥ sa evoktaḥ kāyavajraḥ sa eva hi | kāyavajradharo brahmā sa eva parigīyate || 18 ||
ānandaṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ rūpakāyaḥ sa ucyate | cakrahastaḥ sa evoktaḥ kāyo nirmāṇalakṣaṇaḥ || 19 ||
vivṛtyā sa ca vaimalyo jāgratakṣaya eva saḥ | sa eva picuvajra syāt aṣṭāsyo herukaḥ smṛtaḥ || 20 ||
catuḥ pādo mahāvīro bhujaṣoḍaśasaṃyutaḥ | evaṃ kāyaprabhedena caturtho herukaḥ smṛtaḥ || 21 ||
svābhāvikāt bhaved dharma dharmāt saṃbhoga eva saḥ | tasmāt nirmāṇakāyaḥ syādevaṃ kāya catuṣṭayam || 22 ||
kāyavajradharo brahmā vāgvajrastu maheśvaraḥ | cittavajradharo viṣṇuḥ vajrasattvo mahāsukhaḥ || 23 ||
iti nirdeśo mūlatantre ca trikulasya nidāne |
svābhāvikena saṃyuktaṃ catuḥkulamiti smṛtam | catuḥkāritabhedena kulānāṃ sā vyavasthitiḥ || jñātavyo yogayuktena buddhamārgābhilāṣiṇā iti || 24 ||
evaṃkāro vajrasattvaḥ | hūṃkāraḥ cittavajraḥ | āḥ kāro vāgvajraḥ | oṃkāraḥ kāyavajraḥ | evaṃ hūṃ āḥ oṃ anayā ekekākṣarasaṃjñayā pratipādito'rtho grāhyo nākṣarasaṃjñā | atra saṃjñā na bhāvo yadi syāt tadā manasā cakṣuṣā grāhyā bhavati | na caivaṃ tasmācchrotre saṃjñā gṛhyate | anayā pratipādito'rtho grāhyaḥ | nākṣarasaṃjñā manasā cakṣuṣā gṛhyate | na ca ghaṭapaṭadiko'rtho mṛccakradaṇḍasalīlasūtra vaṃśaśalākātaṃtvādibhiḥ niṣpāditaḥ saṃjñayā janito bhavati | śabdamātreṇa saṃjñāyā | na pṛthivyādi gandhādi dharmakāraṇabhūtā mṛttikeva bhavati | iti bhagavataḥ prativacana-nirdeśaḥ |
idānīṃ punaḥ vajragarbhādhyeṣaṇaṃ bhagavataḥ prativacanaṃ nigadyate |
* vajragarbha āha
hevajraṃ tu bhavet kena kīdṛśaṃ nāmasaṃgraham | hekāreṇa kimākhyātaṃ vajreṇāpi kimucyate || 25 ||
bhagavānāha,
hekāreṇa mahākaruṇā vajraṃ prajñā [ca] bhaṇyate | prajñopāyātmakaṃ tantraṃ tanme nigaditaṃ śṛṇu | iti || 26 ||
asya uddeśasya nirdeśo mūlatantre sa evāvatāryate | tatra bhagavānāha,
sattvadharmanirālambā karuṇeyaṃ tridhā smṛtā | mahāśabdā nirālambā hekāreṇābhidhīyate || 27 ||
kāyavākcittayogena pūrvo vaṃkāra eva saḥ | vajraśabdena ekāraḥ sarvākārā ca śūnyatā || 28 ||
anayoryā samāpattiḥ yogaśabdena gīyate | prajñopāyātmakaṃ tantraṃ yogatantraṃ pragīyate || 29 ||
yogo nopāyaśabdena prajñāśabdena vā bhavet | yogaṃ taṃtramidaṃ [nāma] hevajraṃ hi niranvayam || 30 ||
samājādīni sarvāṇi prajñopāyātmakāni [vai] | yogatantrāṇi sarvāṇi prajñopāyasya nāmabhiḥ || 31 ||
saṃcāro yoginīnāṃ tu yatropāyasya saṃsthitiḥ | saṃvṛtyā yoginītantraṃ bālān āgaditaṃ mayā || 32 ||
yatropāyasya saṃcāraḥ prajñāyā saṃsthitī bhavet | upāyatantraṃ evoktaṃ saṃvṛtyāstu yathā tathā || 33 ||
yathā yathā vicāryante mudrāmaṇḍalabhāvanāḥ | tathā tathā viśīryante utpādavyayalakṣaṇāḥ || 34 ||
prajñopāyasamāpattistrivajrābhedalakṣaṇā | jñānajñeyayoraikyaṃ śūnyatākaruṇādvayam || 35 ||
śūnyatā cānimittaṃ ca tathāprāṇihitaṃ punaḥ | anabhisaṃskāraśca vimokṣāste catvāraḥ parikīrtitāḥ || karuṇā-maitrī-muditā-upekṣā caturthikā brahmavihārāste | sarvadharmāvikalpataḥ nirāvaraṇadharmeṇādvayāstena kalpitāḥ || 36 ||
prajñopāyātmakaṃ tadvat kāyavajrāṇi cādvayāḥ | ṣaḍskandhā dhātavastadvat viṣaya indriyāṇi ca || 37 ||
kriyākarmendriyāṇyeva advayaṃ yena saṃsthitāḥ | saṃvaraḥ sarvabuddhānāṃ evaṃkāre pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 38 ||
paścāttrikulabhedena paṃcakulavibhedataḥ | ṣaṭkulānāṃ prabhedena evaṃ śatavibhedataḥ || prajñopāyātmakaṃ tantraṃ deśyamānaṃ mayā śṛṇveti || 39 ||
bhagavataḥ prativacananirddeśa iti yogatantre pratiṣṭhāniyamaḥ |
idānīṃ yoginīnāṃ utpattikāraṇamucyate | iha tantre yoginyaḥ paṃcaskandhāḥ catvāri dhātavaḥ ṣaḍāyatanāni paṃcadaśacandrakalābhedena nairātmādayaḥ | tāsāmutpatisthitikāraṇaṃ huṃkāro | heruko dvitīyaḥ tasmāttāsāṃ sāmarthyaṃ jñānavijñānaṃ devatānāṃ yathodayaḥ syāt | evaṃ
* dṛṣṭayākṛṣṭī mahācchomaṃ sāmarthyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ viduḥ | stambhanoccāṭanaṃ caiva sainyastambhābhicārukam || 40 ||
aparamapi vakṣyamāṇaṃ he vajragarbha śruṇuśca tvam | iti devatotpattisthitikāraṇaniyamaḥ | idānīṃ tasyāpyutpattikāraṇamucyate |
* prathamaṃ tāvadbhavedevamiti |
evaṃkāraḥ prathamaṃ kāraṇaṃ herukasya hūṃkāraśca utpattikāraṇaṃ dvitīyasyeti niyamaḥ |
tasmādutpadyate bhāvo grāhyagrāhakabhedataḥ | viṣayendriyormārge vijñānānāṃ pṛthak pṛthak || 41 ||
* badhyante bhāvabandhena |
tena bhāvabandhena vijñānādi cakṣurādi nibadhyante |
mucyante tat parijñayā |
teṣāṃ viṣayendriyāṇāṃ nirodhena tatparijñāneneti | tato
* bhāve naivaṃ vimucyante
divyacakṣurādibhiratītānāgataviṣayāvalokanena ṣaḍvijñānāni vimucyante | anyattadvijñānamiti bhagavato vacanāt | tathānyad taddvapādikamapi | ataḥ
sarvataḥ pāṇipādyaṃ [tad] sarvato'kṣiśiro mukham | sarvataḥ śrutimān loka sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhatīti || 42 ||
idānīṃ pūrvoktaṃ prajñopāyayoḥ paramārtha-bhāvanocyate |
* bhāvaṃ bhāvyamityādinā
ihākāśabhāvaṃ bhāvyaṃ svapnopamaṃ paramāṇudharmatātītam | tasya parijñayā abhāvaṃ bhāvyaṃ vikalparahitacittena pratibhāsālokanam |
kalpanāpoḍhamabhrāntaṃ pratyakṣamityucyate |
tadeva caturvidhaṃ indriyapratyakṣaṃ mānasapratyakṣaṃ yogipratyakṣaṃ svasaṃvedanapratyakṣamiti | tadeva jñānamupadarśakaṃ pravartakaṃ prāpakamanubhavalakṣaṇaṃ ceti | sa eva pratibhāso navadṛṣṭāntaiḥ sādhitaḥ tadyathā pratibhāsāḥ nirmitanagaraḥ pratiśabdaḥ svapnaṃ māyā yatraḥ marīcikā ādarśapratibimbaḥ udakacandraḥ ākāśa iti | bhavet prajñā ekāraḥ ||
* tadvaddhi herukamiti |
abhāvaṃ bhāvyaṃ prajñājñānam | herukaṃ mahāsukham | yathā prajñā tathopāyaḥ | tasya parijñayā abhāvaṃ ca bhāvyaṃ bhavedupāyaḥ | tadvat śabdo'tra yathā hetu tathā phalamiti | evaṃkāraḥ prajñopāyātmakaḥ dehastho nābhisthaḥ | evaṃ
* dehasthaṃ tu mahājñānaṃ sarvasaṃkalpavarjitaṃ siddham |
maṇḍalacakrakarmajñānamudrākalpanārahitam | prajñāpāramitājñānaṃ vikalpajālarahitamiti niyamaḥ | sa eva vajrasatvaḥ trailokyākṣepaherukaḥ svābhāvikakāyaḥ |
* vyāpakaḥ sarvavastunāmiti |
ṣaḍskandhāḥ ṣaḍdhātavaḥ ṣaḍindriyāṇi ṣaḍviṣayāḥ ṣaḍkarmendriyāṇi ṣaḍkarmendriyakriyāḥ | eṣāṃ vastūnāṃ vyāpako jñānakāyaḥ |
* dehastho'pi na dehaja iti |
utpādavyayābhāvāt | iha yadvakṣyamāṇe ḍākinījālasaṃvare siddhinirṇayapaṭale dvitīyakalpe vajragarbhādhyeṣaṇaṃ bhagavataḥ prativacanam | tat saṃvṛtyā bālajanānāṃ prabodhanārthaṃ dvindriyasukhaṃ deśitaṃ utpannakrameṇeti | tadyathā vajragarbha āha,
utpannakramayogena satsukhaṃ hi mahāsukham utpanno bhāvanāhīnaḥ utpattyā kiṃ prayojanamiti || 43 ||
atrotpannakramo nāma kalpanādvindriyasukharahitaḥ | sa eva buddhatvadāyakaḥ tasmāt kalpanayā maṇḍalotpatyā mudrotpattyā kiṃ prayojanamiti | idaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā hevajra bhagavānāha
aho śraddhāvegena naṣṭo mahābodhisattva iti | saṃvṛtyā dehābhāve mahāsaukhyaṃ saukhyaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate | vyāpyavyāpakarūpeṇa sukhena vyāpitaṃ jagat || 44 ||
yathā puṣpāśritaṃ gandhaṃ puṣpābhāve na labhyate | tathā rūpādyabhāvena saukhyaṃ naivopalamyate || iti saṃvṛtyā || 45 ||
tatraiva punaḥ pratiṣedho vivṛtyā | tadyathā
bhāvo'haṃ naiva bhāvo'hamiti sarvākārāprajñā buddho'haṃ vastubodhanāditi |
ṣaḍabhijñā upāyaḥ |
so na jānanti ye mūḍhā itthaṃbhūtaṃ kausīdyāpahataśca iti |
dvindriyasukhenāpahataśca iti dvindriyasukhenāpahatā | ityādinā pūrvāparaṃ neyaṃ nītārthaṃ tasminneva paṭale vistareṇa vaktavyam |
atra punaḥ kulapaṭaloktamucyate | iha traidhātukaṃ carācaramatītānāgata-vartamānavyāpitvādyadi buddhajñānaṃ dehajaṃ bhavati | ādhārādheyasaṃbaṃdhena yathā puṣpajaṃ gandhaṃ tadabhāve vinaśyati | yathā puṣpābhāve gandhaṃ na caivam | ato bāhye dehe ca vyāpitvāt bāhyasthaṃ dehasthamityucyate | dehābhāve na tasyābhāvo yasmāttasmāt na dehajamiti niyamaḥ | tathā āha
ākāśasya yathā bhaṅgo nāsti kumbhasya bhaṅgataḥ | jñānasya ca tathā nāsti bhaṅgo dehasya bhaṅgataḥ || 46 ||
iti ṣaṭsāhasrikāyāṃ hevajraṭīkāyāṃ prajñopāyādvayajñānaniyamaḥ tṛtīyaḥ paricchedaḥ |

atra vajragarbha āha he bhagavān vajradehe katame nāḍyaḥ | bhagavānāha dvātriṃśannāḍyaḥ | dvātriṃśat bodhicittāvahā mahāsukhasthāne sravantyaḥ iti |
iha mahāsukha iti | mahāsukhasaṃvedanāt mahāsukha iti ucyate | guhyacakraṃ dvātriṃśannāḍikātmakaṃ kakārādi ṣaḍvargatriṃśadvyaṃjanānāhatādvayalakṣaṇam | tatrākāśavāyutejaüdakapṛthvījñānadhātudharmeṇa evaṃkāra dharmeṇeti | tadyathā kākhāgāghāṅā ityākāśadhātavaḥ | akuhavirsajanīyaḥ kaṇṭhyāḥ iti | hakārajñāpakāt tanmadhye patitaḥ tad grahaṇena gṛhyata iti paribhāṣayā siddhaḥ kavarga ākāśadhāturiti | evaṃ ca cāchājājhāñā iti | icūyaśa tālavyāḥ iti | vāyudhāturyakāra-jñāpakāt | tathā ṭāṭhāḍāḍhāṇā iti ṛṭūraṣā mūrdhanyā iti | tejodhātu repha-jñāpakāt | evaṃ pāphābābhāmā iti upūpadhmāni oṣṭhyā iti | toyadhātuḥ vakārajñāpakāt | evaṃ tāthādādhānā iti ḷtulasā dantyāḥ [iti] pṛthvīdhātuḥ lakāra jñāpakāt | eṣāṃ madhye sāśāṣājñā iti pṛthāptejavāyuākāśasvabhāvāḥ paṃcātmā ṣaṣṭho jñānadhātu svabhāvā iti | evaṃkārākṣaradvayam | evaṃkārādayo bodhicittasyākarṣakā yena tena bodhicittāvahā uktāḥ | mahāsukhasthāne sravantyaḥ iti mūtraviṭśukraṃ sravantyaḥ |
* tāsāṃ madhye'dhaḥ ūrdhvaṃ trīṇi nāḍyaḥ pradhānāḥ |
adho viṭsrāvinī mūtrasrāvinī śukrasrāvinī nābheradhaḥ | nābherurdhvaṃ lalanā-rasanāvadhūtītiṃ |
* lalanā prajñāsvabhāvena rasanopāyena saṃsthitā | avadhūtī madhyadeśe tu grāhyagrāhakavarjitā || 1 || iti
atra prajñāśabdena candro'bhidhīyate tasya vāmanāsāpuṭe prāṇavāhasvabhāvaḥ | tena candrasvabhāveneti prāṇabāhinī lalanā sthitā | upāyaśabdena sūryo'bhidhīyate | tasya dakṣiṇanāsāpuṭe prāṇavāhasvabhāvaḥ | tena svabhāvena rasanā sthitā | tathāha
dinaṃ tu bhagavān vajrī naktaṃ prajñā prakīrtitā | yathādityaḥ śivaḥ proktaḥ candraḥ śaktiḥ tathā smṛtā || 2 ||
vijñāna-saṃskāra-vedanā-saṃjñā-rūpaṃ paṃcamaṇḍalasṛṣṭikrameṇa lalanā sthitā | pṛthvī-toya-tejo-vāyu-dhātvākāśamaṇḍalasaṃhārakrameṇa rasanā sthitā | dvādaśalagnaparivartena viṣamasamalagnaprakāreṇa triṃśat triṃśat maṇḍalabhoginī lalanā-rasanā | atra makaralagne maṇḍalāni pṛthivyādīni yathākramam | tadyathā kākhāgāghāṅā iti | tato vilomena kumbhe hrasvākṣarāṇi sṛṣṭikrameṇa vāmanāḍyām | tadyathā ṅaghagakhaka ityākāśādīni vijñānādīni | dakṣiṇe'pyevaṃ ca rupādīni pṛthivyādīni vākkāyabhāvabhedena grāhyagrāhakasambandheneti | evaṃ mīnodaye cāchājājhāñā iti dakṣiṇe saṃhārakrameṇa | tato meṣodaye ñajhajachaca iti vāmesṛṣṭikrameṇa | tathā vṛṣodaye | ṭāṭhāḍāḍhāṇā iti | evaṃ mithunodaye ṇaḍhaḍaṭhaṭa iti | tat karkaṭodaye pāphābābhāmā iti | evaṃ mabhabaphapa siṃhodaye | tāthādādhānā iti kanyodaye | nadhadathata iti tulālagne | sāṣāśājñākṣā iti vṛścike | tataḥ kṣajñaśaṣasa iti dhanulagne | evamahorātreṇa ṣaṣṭimaṇḍalāni | evamabhyantarā nāḍyo maṇḍalavāhinyaḥ | tāsāṃ jñāpakāstebhyo jātā hastapādasandhiṣu ucyante | dakṣiṇe skandhabāhusandhau makaralagnaṃ tasya pratyeka maṇḍalātmakam | pṛthvyādi maṇḍalaṃ | aṃguṣṭhatarjanī-madhyamānāmikā-kaniṣṭhāṅgulānāmadhyaḥ parvasandhiṣu yathānukrameṇeti | tataḥ kumbhalagne vāme skandhabāhuḥ sandhau maṇḍalānyākāśādīni | yathānukrameṇa kaniṣṭhānāmikā-madhyamā-tarjanyaṅguṣṭhādyadhaḥ parvasandhiṣu | evaṃ dakṣiṇabāhūpabāhusandhau mīnalagnaḥ | aṅguṣṭhādidvitīya parvapaṃktiṣu maṇḍalāni sandhiṣu pṛthivyādīni maṇḍalāni | evaṃ vāma-bāhūpabāhusandhau meṣalagnaṃ kaniṣṭhādi dvitīyapadapaṃktiṣu sandhiṣu tato dakṣiṇa-hastopabāhusandhau vṛṣalagnamaṅguṣṭhāditṛtīyaparvapaṃktisandhiṣu maṇḍalāni ca | evaṃ amoghabāhuhastasandhau mithunalagnaṃ kaniṣṭhāditṛtīyaparvapaṃktisandhiṣu maṇḍalānīti ca | evaṃ uttarāyaṇa niyamaḥ | tato dakṣiṇāyane | tadyathā dakṣiṇa-kaṭyūru-sandhau karkaṭalagnaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhādi prathamapadapaṃktisandhiṣu pṛthvyādīni maṇḍalāni yathākrameṇeti | tato vāma kaṭyurusandhau siṃhalagnaṃ vāmapādakaniṣthādīnāṃ prathama padapaṃktisandhiṣu ākāśādīni maṇḍalāni yathākrameṇeti | evaṃ dakṣiṇajānūrusandhau kanyālagnaṃ aṅguṣṭhādi dvitīyaparvapaṃktisandhiṣu maṇḍalāni | evaṃ vāmapādajānūru sandhau tulālagnaṃ kaniṣṭhādi dvitīyapadapaṃktisandhiṣu maṇḍalāni | evaṃ dakṣiṇapādajānu-sandhau vṛścikalagnaṃ aṅguṣṭhādi-tṛtīyapadapaṃktisandhiṣu maṇḍalāni | evaṃ vāmapāde jānusandhau dhanulagnaṃ kaniṣṭhāditṛtīyapadapaṃktisandhiṣu maṇḍalāni yathākramam | evaṃ ṣaṣṭimaṇḍalāni | nirmāṇacakre catvāriśūnyasthānāni evaṃkāra svabhāveneti | ato nirmāṇacakre catvāriśūnya-sthānāni evaṃkāra svabhāveneti | ato nirmāṇacakre catuḥṣaṣtidalaṃ padmam | dalaśabdena ṣaṣṭimaṇḍalavāhinyo nāḍikā ucyante | catuḥ śūnyavāhinya iti | evaṃ pratyeka lagnanāḍyāṃ paṃcasthānāni bhavanti | madhye śūnyavāhinīnāḍī pūrve vāyuvāhinī savye tejovāhinī uttare toyavāhinī paścime pṛthvīvāhinī | madhye avadhūtī jñānamaṇḍalavāhinī | uktaṃ ca |
nābhimadhye sthito vīraḥ karṇikāgūḍhagocare |
evaṃ ṣaṣṭidaṇḍāḥ ṣaṣṭimaṇḍalavāhikāḥ | catasraḥ śūnyavāhakā kṣaṇamātraṃ yathā candrasya ṣoḍaśīkalā tathā sa jñeyā na te paripūrṇavāhakā iti nirmāṇacakre | viṣamalagnaṃ candrasvabhāvena lalanā | samalagnaṃ sūryasvabhāvena rasanā | avadhūtī samaviṣamagrāhyagrāhakavarjitā madhyadeśe tu jñānamaṇḍalajñāpakā iti | evaṃ nirmāṇacakre daṇḍasaṃkrāntayaḥ catuṣṣaṣṭiśūnyāścatasraḥ tato dharmacakre aṣṭadalaṃ padmam | tatrāṣṭadaleṣu praharabhedenāṣṭasaṃkrāntayaḥ sārdhalagnātmikālalanāyā rasanā yā iti | tataḥ sambhogacakre hrasvavyaṃjanabhedena kaṇṭhe dvātriṃśannāḍyaḥ | saṃbhoge dvātriṃśaddalapadmaṃ gurupadeśataḥ vilomena tantre proktam | tasmin muhūrtabhedena dvātriṃśat saṃkrāntayaḥ | lalāṭe ṣoḍaśadalapadmam | tatrāha praharabhedena ṣoḍaśasaṃkrāntayaḥ | uṣṇīṣe caturdalapadmam | tatra sandhyābhedena catasraḥ saṃkrāntayaḥ |
atra bāhye prāṇanirgame tataḥ prāṇanirgamekāle nirmāṇacakre daṇḍanāḍīmaṇḍalānāṃ nāsārandhre udayo bhavati | nāsārandhradvaye vāme vā dakṣiṇe vā | ādau ante vā yadākāśamaṇḍalaṃ vahati tadā madhyaṃ vahati | yadā vāyumaṇḍalaṃ vahati tadā nāsāpuṭe ūrdhvaṃ spṛśati | yadā tejomaṇḍalaṃ vahati tadā nāsārandhra-dakṣiṇaṃ spṛśati | yadā toyamaṇḍalaṃ vahati tadā toyaṃ spṛśati ca nāsābhimukhaṃ vāme vā dakṣiṇe vā | yadā pṛthvī-maṇḍalaṃ vahati tadā adhaḥ spṛśati | evaṃ nāsārandhrayoḥ paṃcasthānāni yoginā jñātavyāni | vāme vā dakṣiṇe vā viṣamasamalagnādayabhedeneti iha paṃcalakṣahevajre asya yo nirdeśaḥ saṃbahulatvāt na kathito, bahukathanena alpaśrutāḥ trāsaṃ gacchantīti bhagavato niyamaḥ | idaṃ dvādaśa-lagnātmakaṃ rāśicakraṃ makarādikaṃ catuḥ pīṭhe jñātavyam | ariṣṭalakṣaṇaṃ ca tantratantrāntareṇa bodhavyamiti vacanāt | rohitāmohitādayo nāḍyaḥ viṣama-samalagnavāhinya iti | sandhyābhāṣāntareṇoktam | tābhiḥ nāḍibhiḥ śubhāśubhaṃ tatra kathitaṃ ariṣṭaṃ maraṇaṃ ceti | atra kāraṇāt |
* akṣobhyāvahā lalanā rasanā raktapravāhini | prajñā candrāvahā khyātā avadhūtī sā prakīrtitā || 3 ||
iha akṣobhyastoyadhātuḥ toyadhātuvāhinī vāme nāsāpuṭe lalanā | raktaṃ tejodhātuḥ tejodhātuvāhinī dakṣiṇe rasanā | evaṃ padmaṃ toyajaṃ vāme | dakṣiṇe'gnijaṃ ratnamadhidevatā | prajñāvadhūtī candro binduḥ śukraṃ tadeva paṃcātmakaṃ mahāśūnyaṃ vahatīti | śūnyāvāhamadhye vajrakulādhidevatāvadhūtī prakīrtitā | evaṃ candrasūryarāhuvāhinyo lalanārasanāvadhūtī yathākrameṇa prāṇasaṃcāre | apāne viṇmūtraśukravāhinyo nābheradhaḥ | cakrakhaḍgaekasūkavajrāṇi ūrdhvamukhī iti |
* abhedyādaya iti
atra svarāḥ śuklapakśepaṃcadaśa ṣoḍaśamo binduḥ | tāśca nāḍikānālambikā veṣṭayitvā sthitā | tadyathā aiuṛḷ iti pratipad dvitīyā tṛtīyā caturthī paṃcamī yathānukrameṇa evaṃ guṇāḥ a e ar o al iti | ṣaṣṭyādi yathānukrameṇa | tatra yaṇādeśā hayaravala iti ekādaśyādayānukrameṇa bindu madhye lambikā ṣoḍaśamī | evaṃ tālukordhvalalāṭe sravanti śuklakalāsvabhāvenāmṛtam | bāhye śiśiraḥ adhyātmani stukamiti | evaṃ pratyekanāḍī | tadyathā
* abhedyāḥ sūkṣmarūpā ca divyā vāmā tu vāminī iti
pratipadādayaḥ paṃca | tataḥ
* kūrmmajā bhāvakī sekā doṣā viṣṭā || 4 || iti
ṣaṣṭhayādayaḥ |
* mātrikā śarvarī sītadā uṣmā lalanā | iti
ekādaśyādayaḥ yathānukrameṇa lalanā paṃcadaśātmikā avadhūtī ṣoḍaśīti | tataḥ kṛṣṇapratipadādayo rasanāyām dīrghasvarasvabhāvena paṃcadaśatithayaḥ saṃhārakrameṇa | tadyathā lāvārāyāhā iti pratipad-dvitīyā-tṛtīyā-caturthī-paṃcamī yathānukrameṇa | tato guṇavṛddhibhedena | āl au ār ai ā iti | ṣaṣṭhyādayo yathānukrameṇa | tato dīrghasvarabhedena ḹ ū ṝ ī ā iti ekādaśyādayo yathānukrameṇa | jihvagre visargaḥ ṣoḍaśamaḥ āsāṃ madhye iti rasanādayaḥ | tadyathā

pratipadādayaḥ |

ṣaṣṭhyādayaḥ |
* traivṛttā kāminī gehā caṇḍā kātyāyanī || 6 ||
ekādaśyādayaḥ | evaṃ paṃcadaśa | jihvāyāṃ madhye māradārikā kālasūtrasvarūpeṇa jihvāgre yāvad sthitā lambikāyāḥ srāvaḥ pibati | rasanā iti |

bhagavānāha tribhava pariṇatāḥ sarvā iti |
skandha-dhātu-karmendriyapariṇatā iti |

* saṃvaraṃ sarvabuddhānāṃ evaṃkāre pratiṣṭhitam |
guhyakamale dvātriṃśaddalake | uṣṇīṣe caturdalake | śeṣānāṃ saṃvṛtyā nirmāṇa-dharma-saṃbhoga-sahaja-cakreṣu saṃvaro melāpakaḥ catuḥṣaṣṭīdale aṣṭadale dvātriṃśaddalake ṣoḍaśadale nābhau hṛdaye kaṇṭhe lalāṭe ca | āli lalāṭe kāli kaṇṭhe prajñā hṛdaye nābhau upāyaḥ | sahajakāyo nābhau | dharmakāyo hṛdaye | saṃbhogakāyaḥ kaṇṭhe | nirmāṇakāyo lalāṭe | tūryā nābhau | hṛdaye suṣuptaḥ | kaṇṭhe svapnaḥ | lalāṭe jāgrataḥ | lalāṭe kāyavajram | kaṇṭhe vāgvajram | hṛdaye cittavajram | nābhau jñānavajram | ekāro nābhau vaṃkāro hṛdaye makāro kaṇṭhe yākāro lalāṭe nābhau locanā hṛdaye māmakī kaṇṭhe pāṇḍarā lalāṭe tāriṇī catasṛṇāṃ maṇḍalānīti | catvāraḥ kṣaṇāḥ | vicitro lalāṭe vipākaḥ kaṇṭhe vimardo hṛdaye vilakṣaṇaṃ nābhau | evamānando lalāṭe paramānandaḥ kaṇṭhe hṛdaye viramānandaḥ nābhau sahajānandaḥ | evaṃ duḥkhasatyaṃ lalāṭe | samudayasatyaṃ kaṇṭhe | nirodhasatyaṃ hṛdaye | mārgasatyaṃ nābhau | catvāri tattvāni | ātmatattvaṃ lalāṭe mantratattvaṃ kaṇṭhe devatātattvaṃ hṛdaye jñānatattvaṃ nābhau | lalāṭe ahaṃkāraḥ | kaṇṭhe śabdoccāraḥ | hṛdaye sarvacintā | nābhau sukhavedanā | catvāro nikāyāḥ | sthāvarīyo nābhau hṛdaye sarvāstivādaḥ kaṇṭhe saṃvidāyā lalāṭe mahāsāṃghikāḥ candro lalāṭe sūrya kaṇṭhe hṛdaye rāhūḥ nābhyāṃ kālāgniḥ | lalāṭe ṣoḍaśasaṃkrāntayaḥ kaṇṭhe dvātriṃśat hṛdaye aṣṭau nābhyāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭī saṃkrāntayaḥ | pūrvoktā catuḥsandhyāḥ | pūrvasandhyā lalāṭe madhyāhnasandhyā kaṇṭhe aparāhnasandhyā hṛdaye ūrdhvarātrasandhyā nābhau | lalāṭe bhogaḥ kaṇṭhe'dhikāraḥ hṛdaye layaḥ nābhyāṃ prabhutvam | evaṃ sarve catvāraḥ | ṣaṭtriṃśat bodhipākṣikādharmāḥ | ṣaḍtriṃśat dhātavaḥ | pūrvoktāḥ caturvibhāgaṃ kṛtvā sarve catuḥ catuḥ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ kulabhedena cakre prayojanīyāḥ yathā mūlatantrānusāreṇa tantra-tantrāntareṇoktaṃ vidhinā ṣaṭkulabhedena ṣaḍcakreṣu saṃvaraḥ | paṃcakulabhedena paṃcacakreṣu saṃvaraḥ trikulabhedena tricakreṣu saṃvaraḥ | iti niyamaḥ |
trikulaṃ catuḥkulaṃ tantraṃ paṃcakulaṃ ṣaṭkulaṃ tathā | vyāpyavyāpakabhedenādhārādheyabhedataḥ || 1 ||
atrālayaḥ | ekakulādhārabhedena ekamukhaḥ | trikulādhārabhedena trimukhaḥ | catuḥkulādhārabhedena caturmukhaḥ | paṃcakulādhārabhedena paṃcamukhaḥ | ṣaṭkulādhārabhedena ṣaṇmukhaḥ | aṣṭakulādhārabhedena aṣṭānana iti | atra kālāgnibhedenaikamukhaḥ smṛtaḥ | rāhubhedenaikena prajñopāyātmakairdvimukhaḥ | kāyavākcittacandrasūryarāhūbhedena trimukhaḥ | candrasūryarāhūkālāgnikāyavākcittajñānabhedena caturmukhaḥ | paṃcaskandhabhedena paṃcānanaḥ | ṣaṭskandhabhedena ṣaḍānanaḥ | dvidhā candraḥ dvidhā sūryaḥ dvidhā rāhuḥ dvidhā kālāgniḥ eṣāṣṭabhedenāṣṭānanaḥ atra candrabhedo lalāṭe lambikācakram | sūryabhedo jihvāyāṃ kaṇṭhacakram | rāhubhedo hṛdaye uṣṇīṣa cakram | kālāgnibhedo nābhau guhyacakramiti | tathāha
rāhumurdhnisthitaḥ sūryaḥ sūryasyopari candramā | candrasyopari rāhukaṃ tena viśvaṃ pravartate || 2 ||
kālāgnidrāvakaḥ tasya nābhau guhye dvidhā sthitaḥ | vajrasūryaḥ sa evoktaḥ caṇḍālī yatra saṃsthitā || 3 ||
amṛtaṃ saṃsthitaṃ yatra haṃkārastatra saṃsthitaḥ | uṣṇīṣakamale varṣan vajrendu-vimalaprabhaḥ || 4 || iti saṃvarabhedaniyamaḥ ||
idānīṃ caṇḍālī-yoga ucyate | caṇḍālītyādinā |
caṇḍālī jvalitā nābhau dahati paṃcatathāgatān | dahati locanādīnāṃ dagdhe haṃ sravate śaśī || 5 || ityuddeśapadam ||
asyoddeśasya nirdeśapadaṃ mūlatantrādavatāryate | tatra bhagavānāha
vajragarbha pravakṣyāmi guhyādguhyataraṃ śṛṇu | kāraṇaṃ sarvasiddhīnāṃ yogināṃ muktidāyakam || 6 ||
vajrasattvo ya ākhyāto jñānakāyo niranvayaḥ | trisūkaṃ varakaṭe nātho nābhiguhyāntare sthitaḥ || 7 ||
adhaḥ urdhvaṃ nirgatā tasya vidyuddaṇḍasamaprabhā | codayanti śarīrasthān vijñānendriyadhātukān || 8 ||
nābhau sā madhyame sūke saṃsthitā bhuvaneśvarī | guhye dakṣiṇe sūke patamānā yathā taḍit || 9 ||
svābhaprajñā sā vikhyātā caṇḍālī sā'tra kathyate | tasyā'dhaḥ trisūkāni ūrdhve trīṇi tathaiva ca || 10 ||
brahmasūkaṃ sthitaṃ madhye viṣṇusūkaṃ hi vāmataḥ | dakṣiṇe rudrasūkaṃ tu viṇmūtraśukravāhakam || 11 ||
rāhusūkaṃ sthitaṃ madhye candrasūkaṃ tu vāmataḥ | dakṣiṇe sūryasūkaṃ tu toyāgnyākāśavāhakam || 12 ||
lalanā vāme vikhyātā rasanā dakṣiṇe smṛtā | madhyame hyavadhūtī sthāt ḍombinī vāyu kathyate || 13 ||
nābhe hṛdayato madhye tripathaṃ kṛtvā punargatāḥ | hṛdayāt kaṇṭhamadhye tu tripathaṃ kṛtvā punargatāḥ || 14 ||
lalāṭe kaṇṭhayormadhye tripathaṃ kṛtvā punargatāḥ | lalaṭoṣṇīṣayormadhye tripathaṃ kṛtvā punargatāḥ || 15 ||
uṣṇīṣa-nāsikāmadhye tripathaṃ kṛtvā punargataḥ | nāsikāvāmarandhre tu lalanā saṃvyavasthitāḥ || 16 ||
dakṣiṇe rasanā nāḍī madhye cāvadhūtikā | nābhyādi paṃcacakrāṇi tripathaṃ paṃcadhaiva taiḥ || 17 ||
karṇikākarṇikā madhye avadhūtyā gatirāgatiḥ | patrebhyo'pi patreṣu, lalanārasanayoḥ smṛtā || 18 ||
nābhe rāhustataḥ sūryaḥ candraṃ candrāṅkameva ca | bhedayitvā gatoṣṇīṣaṃ nāḍikā sāvadhūtikā || 19 ||
kāmonmādo yadā pūṃsāṃ lalanārasanāpyatha | tathoḥ saṃpuṭayogena caṇḍālī jvalati dhruvam || 20 ||
jvalitā nābhicakre sā ḍombīmārgeṇa niḥsṛtā | rāhukaṃ śaśinaṃ bhitvā haṃkāraṃ taṃ ca sā spṛśet || 21 ||
tathā tu spṛṣṭaḥ sa haṃkāro dravate amṛtaṃ sitam | skandhadhātvādike dagdhe paṃcamaṇḍala vāhike || 22 ||
viṣayendriyaniruddhe cānandādyai samucchrite | sravanti bindunīndo haṃkāro mūrdhni saṃsthitaḥ || 23 ||
lalāṭe candrataḥ sūrye kaṇṭhādrāho tato gataḥ | nābhau caṇḍālikā viṣṭā guhyacakre tato gatā || 24 ||
saṃpāte guhyacakre'smin kathito'yaṃ mahāpaśuḥ | triśūlādhaḥ trināḍīnāṃ yatra randhraṃ pradarśitam || 25 ||
saptajanmapaśuścaiva khecarīsiddhidāyakaḥ | mūrcchrito harate vyādhiṃ jāritaḥ skandhadhātukam || 26 ||
dadāti cakravartitvaṃ viṣayendriyamāritaḥ | khecaratvaṃ dadātyeṣa aṇimādiguṇairyutaḥ || 27 ||
buddhatvaṃ dadate kṣipraṃ jāgrādyairanusārataḥ | bāhye sūto yathā baddhaḥ tathā jñānaraso'pyayam || 28 ||
evaṃ brahmāpaśurviṣṇurguhyacakre nipātitaḥ | dadāti vipulaṃ āyuryāvadāhṛta saṃplavaḥ || 29 ||
ūrdhve rāhūḥ paśuḥ proktaḥ candrasūryo mahāpaśu | pātito[tā] brahmarandhreṇa bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ || 30 ||
raktaṃ snāyustathā masja pātanīyā prayatnataḥ | eteva paśavo jñe[yā] nānye bāhyastu dehinaḥ || 31 ||
saptajanmā tu sarveṣāṃ paśūnāṃ parameśvaraḥ | saptajanmā yathā dehe tathā vakṣyāmi tata śṛṇu || 32 ||
annapānarasaṃ bhuktaṃ pītaṃ ca ṣaḍvidham | pākato rasatāṃ yāti prathamaṃ janma ucyate || 33 ||
tasmādrudhiratāṃ yāti dvitīyaṃ bhavati sphuṭam | tṛtīyaṃ māṃsatāṃ yāti caturthaścarmatāṃ vrajet || 34 ||
nāḍītvaṃ paṃcame yāti asthitvaṃ yāti ṣaṣthame | saptame majjatāṃ yāti saptāvarto tato bhavediti || 35 ||
tasyaivādheyayogena ṣaṭkoṣaṃ kulamucyate | kulaṃ śarīraṃ ityuktaṃ koleyaṃ śukramucyate || 36 ||
tasya śaktiḥ rajaḥ proktā śarīrotpattikāraṇam | vijñānaṃ vyāpakaṃ jñānaṃ tayormadhye vyvavasthitam || 37 ||
candrādityaṃ samāgamya herukaḥ tribhavātmakaḥ | ūrdhvādhaḥ saṃsthito vīro ḍākinīcakranāyakaḥ || 38 ||
catubhirnāḍikābhiścoṣṇīṣacakramucyate | ṣoḍaśabhirlalāṭe ca dvātriṃśadbhiśca kaṇṭhake || 39 ||
hṛdaye cāṣṭabhiścakraṃ catuḥṣaṣṭibhireva ca | nābhicakraṃ samākhyātaṃ dvātriṃśadbhiśca guhyake || 40 ||
cakrāro nāḍikāḥ proktā athavā padmadalāni vai | ādheyāsteṣu yoginyaḥ kriyāṅkurvantyanekadhā || viṣayendriyasvabhāvena vijñānena pracoditāḥ || 41 ||
sarvaṃ pīṭhopapīṭhādyaṃ nāḍīpadmadalāni tat | caturddevībhiruṣṇīṣe mahāmāyā prakathyate || 42 ||
udayo nābhicakre'sya prathame parimaṇḍale | lalāṭe picūvajraṃ syāt aṣṭanāḍī samanvitam || 43 ||
cakṣurdvaye tathā śrotre prāṇe jihvā ca lambikā | gauryādyā devatā hyetā rūpādyā bhūmikādayaḥ || 44 ||
nairātmendukalābhedairasminneva pragīyate | trimukhaḥ ṣaḍbhujaḥ kaṇṭhe dvātriṃśadbhiḥ sa eva hi || 45 ||
hṛdaye cāṣṭadevībhiḥ saṃsthito'yaṃ caturbhujaḥ | cittavajre mahāviṣṇurakṣobhyaḥ kulasaṃbhavaḥ || 46 ||
trailokyākṣepako nābhyāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭibhireva saḥ | paṃcaḍākā amī khyātā ḍākinyaḥ paṃcadhātavaḥ || 47 ||
paṃcacakre sthitā etā guhye ṣaṣtho mahāprabhuḥ | dvātriṃśadbhiḥ ḍākinībhiḥ sārddhaṃ traidhātukeśvaraḥ || 48 ||
ṣaṭcakreṣu devīnāñca ṣaṭpaṃcadaśadhikaṃ śatam | kālacakramiti khyātaṃ ṣaṭkulairekapiṇḍitam || 49 ||
lalāṭe śirasi yā nāḍyo viṃśatiḥ śleṣmavāhikāḥ | catvāriṃ[śa]ntathā kaṇṭhe hṛdaye pittavāhikāḥ || 50 ||
nābhau guhye ṣoḍaśā yā aśīti vāyuvāhakāḥ | saṃnnipātasvabhāvā yā daśanāḍyo guhyacakre || 51 ||
adhordhvaṃ trināḍyo yā ṣaṭ-cakra-nirodhikāḥ | upanāḍyo'nekadhātubhyo dehamāpūrya saṃsthitā || 52 ||
dvāsaptatisahasrāstāḥ tāvatyo devatāḥ tanau | lomasaṃkhyāni bhūtāni sārddhakoṭitrayāṇi ca || 53 ||
keśasaṃkhyā sthitā siddhā yathā bāhye tathā tanau | pāṇīpalaṃ tu ṣaṭśvāsaiḥ ṣaṣṭipāṇīpalairghaṭi || 54 ||
muhūrtekaṃ ghaṭibhyāṃ syāt pādonābhiścatasṛbhiḥ | praharārddhaṃ tad bhavedekaṃ paṃcabhirlagnaṃ bhavet || 55 ||
praharasārddhaṃ lagnaṃ syāt sandhyaukā praharadvayam | tābhiścatasṛbhiḥ proktamahorātraṃ hi dehinām || 56 ||
lagnairdvādaśabhistacca śvāsaiḥ ṣaṭśatādhikaiḥ | ekaviṃśasahasraiśca raverdaṇḍairyathā samā || 57 ||
caturviṃśati pakṣaiśca māsairdvādaśabhistathā | ṛtubhiḥ ṣaḍbhiryathā proktaṃ caturbhiśca samairyugaiḥ || 58 ||
trikālairayanābhyo syāttathā dehe dinaṃ bhavet | śvāsairnavaśataiḥ pakṣo māso'ṣṭādaśabhiḥ śataiḥ || 59 ||
ṣaṭtriṃśadbhiḥ ṛtuḥ proktā catuḥpañcaśatā yugam | dvāsaptatiśataiḥ kālaḥ ayanamaṣṭaśatādhikaiḥ || 60 ||
sahasrairdaśabhistadvat dvābhyāṃ varṣaikamucyate | saṃkrāntau madhyamā śvāsāḥ ṣaṭpaṃcāśat sapādikāḥ || adhikaḥ paṃcasaptatyā ṣaṭśatā dvādaśeṣu ca || 61 ||
evaṃ ca śataśvāsaiḥ tripakṣavarṣatrayam | avadhūtyā bhavet kālaḥ prāṇināṃ mṛtyudāyakaḥ || 62 ||
lalanāyāṃ divārātraṃ yadā vahati mārutaḥ | trivarṣaimaraṇaṃ tasmāt candrasyāriṣṭito bhavet || 63 ||
paṃcarātraṃ yadā sūrye prāṇo vahati dehinām | trivarṣairmaraṇaṃ tasmāt sūryāriṣṭena dakṣiṇe || 64 ||
vāmanāḍyāṃ yadā prāṇo vahatyeṣa dinatrayam | nābhyā rāśidalatyāgaḥ trivarṣādayanakṣayaḥ || dvitīye ṣaḍdinānyevaṃ trimāse vahati dhruvam || 65 ||
evaṃ tribhirtribhirmāsairdinatrayavivardhanāt | ekādaśadalānyaiṣa tyajedvarṣatrayaṃ kramāt || 66 ||
trayaḥ triṃśaddinaṃ yāvat vāmā vahati nirantaram | guṇatrayavibhedena tataḥ sūrye samāviśet || 67 ||
dinatrayaṃ tato madhye karṇikāyāṃ samāviśet | ekarātraṃ tataḥ prāṇo śvāsān tyajati mṛtyutaḥ || 68 ||
daśarātraṃ dakṣiṇe nāḍyāṃ yadā vahati mārutaḥ | dvitīye rāsipatre syāt dvivarṣairmaraṇaṃ tataḥ || 69 ||
tithyākhyairekavarṣaṃ syāt tṛtīye rāsipatrake | caturthe ṣaṇmāsāṃśca viṃśatirdivasān vahet || 70 ||
trimāsāyurvahedyatra paṃcame paṃcaviṃśati | ṣaṣṭhe māsadvayaṃ hyāyūḥ ṣaḍviṃśaddinaṃ vahet || 71 ||
saptame māsamevāyūḥ saptaviṃśaddinaṃ vahet | trayaḥ triṃśaddinānyasmādvahatyeṣa nirantaram || 72 ||
aṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ patraṃ daśamaṃ caikādaśamaṃ kramāt | tyajettāni patrāṇi tithidik paṃcaguṇairdine || 73 ||
savyānāḍī tataḥ tyaktvā vāmāṃ gacchati mārutaḥ | dinadvayaṃ tato yāti dinamekaṃ madhyamāpadam || 74 ||
śvāsakṣayaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā maraṇādutkrāmatyasau | adhaḥ śukrakṣayaṃ yāti ūrdhvaṃ mātṛrajo vrajet || 75 ||
svakarmavāsanābaddhaṃ vijñānaṃ prāṇasaṃyutam | maraṇātpunarbhavaṃ yāti na tu tena vināparam || 76 ||
upādhyāyādyathā vidyā dīpāddīpo yathā bhavet | mudrāyā'parā mudrā darpaṇe mukhato mukham || 77 ||
ravātpratiravotpattiḥ sūryakānte yathā vahniḥ | nārko nārkaṃ vinā jātaḥ jihvāsrāvo'mlabhakṣaṇāt || 78 ||
āmlo nāmlavinā jāto bījādevaṅkuro yathā | na ca tena vinā jātaḥ phalahetusvabhāvataḥ || 79 ||
na svato nāpi parato na dvābhyāṃ nāpyahetutaḥ | utpannā jātu vidyante bhāvāḥ kvacana kecana || 80 ||
piturmātuḥ sitaṃ raktaṃ prāṇāpānadvayaṃ tathā | cittavajra-samāyuktaṃ dehasyotpattikāraṇam || 81 ||
amitābho ratnadhṛkprāṇaḥ apānaśca yathākramaḥ | kāyavākcittarāgāṇi mukhāni cittavajriṇaḥ || 82 ||
śukrādutpadyate candraḥ raktāt sūryasamudbhavaḥ | prāṇato rāhuniṣpattiḥ kālāgnerapyapānataḥ || 83 ||
śukrato nāḍikotpattiḥ śukrādasthisamudbhavaḥ | rajaso raktasaṃbhūtiḥ rakta[āt] māṃsasamudbhavaḥ || 84 ||
māṃsataḥ carmaṇā jātiḥ majjajanmāsthino bhavet | śukraṃ vajraṃ rajo ghaṇṭā nāḍīpadmaṃ mahāmaṇiḥ || 85 ||
raktaṃ cakraṃ tathā'sthini khaḍgo māṃsaṃ tathā smṛtam | utpalaṃ sitapadmañca carmaṃ majjaśca dehinām || 86 ||
etānyaṣṭau svacittasya vaktrāṇi ca yathākramam | pūrva-vaktrāṇi ca pādāḥ syuḥ candrasūryatamognayaḥ || 87 ||
raktato mṛṇmayābhūmiḥ māṃsadhātuḥ pragīyate | śukrataḥ kaṭhinā-bhūmiḥ pāṣāṇāsthimayī ca sā || 88 ||
candrataḥ toyaniṣpatiragnerniṣpattiḥ raktataḥ | rāhutaḥ prāṇaniṣpattiḥ apānasya agnitaḥ smṛtā || 89 ||
śukreṇotpāditā jihvālambikā sarvadehinām | rajasotpāditaṃ netraṃ vāmaṃ caiva tu dakṣiṇam || 90 ||
prāṇenotpāditaṃ nūnaṃ prāṇarandhradvayaṃ tathā | śūnyenaiva saṃjātaṃ śrotrarandhraṃ dvidhā tathā || 91 ||
apānenaiva saṃjātaṃ adhaḥ srotratrayaṃ tathā | rāhuṇotpāditaṃ tu yaḥ stanarandhradvayaṃ tathā || 92 ||
apānenāṇḍayugmaṃ svādevaṃ tanudhātavaḥ | śukreṇaiva tridhā dhātuḥ rajasya tridhāḥ punaḥ || 93 ||
ṣaṭkauṣikamiti khyātaḥ kāyaḥ kāyendriyaṃ dvidhā | toyena janitā vāmā dakṣiṇā janitāgninā || 94 ||
prāṇenaivāmṛtaṃ tasmādurdhvanāḍitrayaṃ smṛtam | vāyunā janitā vāmā medinyā madhyamā tvadhaḥ || 95 ||
savyāpānena nāḍī janitā nātra saṃśayaḥ | lalāṭe saṃsthitaṃ kāyaṃ saṃpūrṇacandramaṇḍale || 96 ||
vāgvajraṃ kaṇṭhadeśe tu saṃpūrṇasūryamaṇḍale | rāhumaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ vijñānaṃ sarvadehinām || 97 ||
pṛthivyā saṃsthitaṃ ratnaṃ rāhupucche na saṃśayaḥ | kālāgni amogho viśvavajropari sthitaḥ || 98 ||
cakraṃ padmaṃ tathā vajraṃ ratnaṃ khaḍgaśca paṃcamaḥ | ṣaṣṭhaḥ vajramaṇau pūṃsāṃ buddhānāṃ śirasi smṛtam || 99 ||
evaṃ ṣaṭkulānyete sarvabuddhā mahābalāḥ | medinyā jāyate gandho'gnipākādraso bhavet || 100 ||
aṅkurādyaṃ bhavettoyāt sparśo'sau vāyuto bhavet | prāṇavātā bhavet śabdaṃ apānād dharmadhātukam || 101 ||
manendriyaṃ hi tatraiva jñātavyaṃ sarvadehinām | yamāntako'sthisaṃbhūto raktātprajñāntakaḥ smṛtaḥ || 102 ||
padmāntakaṃ tu nāḍībhyo māṃsādvighnāntakaḥ smṛtaḥ | majjato'pyacalaḥ proktaḥ ṭarkkirājastu carmataḥ || 103 ||
lomato nīladaṇḍaḥ syānnakhato'pi mahābalaḥ | keśāduṣṇīṣacakrī syāt śumbharājo'dhaḥ keśataḥ || 104 ||
sandhayo hastapāde yā guṇatrayavibhedataḥ | rāśayastā dharādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ dvādaśā smṛtā || 105 ||
ṣaṣṭhi ṛturdinānyete parvāṇi aṅgulikāṣṭḥavaiḥ | adha urdhvaṃ ye sthitā dantā nakṣatrāṇyatra dehinām || 106 ||
dhruvaṃ śukragataṃ mūrdhni rajo'gastiradhogatiḥ | yathā bāhye tathā dehe garbhādutpadyate dhruvam || 107 ||
dvādaśābhyārthaṃ(?) heruko dvādaśairbhujaiḥ | dvādaśāṅganirodhena avasthānāt caturmukhaḥ || 108 ||
ṣoḍaśendukalāhastaḥ ṣoḍaśākāra tattvavit | aṣṭarandhranirodhe[na] aṣṭāsya parameśvaraḥ || 109 ||
candraḥ sūryaḥ tamo vahniḥ padairyena nirodhitaḥ | paścānnirodhayitvā tu caturviṃśatibhirkaraiḥ || 110 ||
caturbhiḥ pūrvavat vaktraiḥ kālacakraḥ samutthitaḥ | catustriṃśatbhujairanyaḥ kādivyaṃjananirodhataḥ || 111 ||
ṣoḍaśasvaranirodhena caraṇāḥ ṣoḍaśaḥ smṛtāḥ | navadvāranirodhena navāsyo vajrabhairavaḥ || 112 ||
evamādīni tantrāṇi kāyavākcittanirodhanāt | deśitāni jinendreṇa bālānāṃ tadviśuddhitaḥ || 113 || iti
mūlatantrādapare vistareṇoktaḥ | bālānāṃ bodhanārthaṃ kiṃciduktam | asyaiva kulasya punaḥ nāḍisaṃcāro laghucakrasaṃvare sārdhadaśaślokapiṇḍārthaṭīkayā jñātavyam | iti bhagavato niyamaḥ | tantratantrāntareṇa boddhavyam | evaṃ triṃśat ślokaiḥ mūlatantrasya piṇḍārthaḥ hevajre kulapaṭale bhagavatoktaḥ |
iti ṣaṭsāhasrikāyāṃ hevajraṭīkāyāṃ caṇḍālīyoga saṃhārotpattikāraṇabhūtaḥ kulapaṭale pañcamaḥ paricchedaḥ |
kulapaṭalaḥ samāptaḥ |

saṃbhogakāyaṃ praṇipatya mūrdhnā nānārutairdeśitamarthamātram | vakṣyāmi yāne'tra tadeva mantraṃ saṃketakenārthamimaṃ kulādyam || 1 ||
mantrasaṃketakaṃ buddhairdvidhā tantre prakāśitam | tathatā-saṃketakaṃ caikaṃ pravyāhāraṃ dvitīyakam || 2 ||
tathatā-saṃketakannāma sarvasatvarutaṃ vacaḥ | dharmaśaṃkho mahāśabdo dharmagaṇḍī mahāraṇaiḥ || 3 ||
apratiṣṭhita-nirvāṇaṃ sarvagā vāṇirucyate | pravyāhāro yato mantraḥ saṃketenārthasūcakaḥ || 4 ||
arthānugamajāpena niḥsvabhāvena cāruṇā | japet mantramabhinnāṅgaṃ napūṃsakapade sthitaḥ || 5 ||
japed prāṇavicchinnamavadhūtīpadaṃ gatam | ekaviṃśatisahasrāṇi ṣaṭśatāni divāniśam || 6 ||
paṃcabhirdivasairlakṣamadhikāṣṭasahasrakaiḥ | kṛṣṇapratipadārabhya yāvat pūrṇātrayaṃ bhavet || 7 ||
śuklapratipadārabhya punaḥ pūrṇātrayaṃ japet | aruṇodgamavelāyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ sa siddhyati || 8 ||
vajrasattvaṃ namaskṛtya dharmacakraṃ pravartayet | sahasrairaṣṭabhirjapaiḥ caturbhirayutaistathā || 9 ||
ṣaṭlakṣairekamāsena prāṇajāpena siddhyati | nākṣasūtraṃ na coccāraṇaṃ homo mantrasya pūjanaṃ || 10 ||
tarpaṇaṃ ca vidhiścānye vinaśyati parāpare | asya japasya ye'śaktā mantriṇo bālabuddhayaḥ || 11 ||
teṣāmeṣo'kṣasūtreṇa pravyāhāraḥ prakāśitaḥ | mantriṇāṃ puṇyalābhāya bāhyabhogābhilāṣiṇām || 12 ||
madhyamāyāṃ haredrogān prāṇo viṣṭo divāniśām | prāṇastithirdinairbaddhaḥ khecaratvaṃ dadātyasau || 13 ||
māsaikaṃ māritohṛdistho amaratvaṃ ca yoginām | ṣaṇmāsaṃ dagdhā nābhyāṃ sarvajñatvaṃ dadāti saḥ || 14 ||
lalāṭe kaṇṭhacakre hṛdaye nābhyāṃ yathākramam | mūrcchito yaḥ tathā baddho mārito dehito nṛṇām || 15 ||
prāṇāpānanirodhena vītarāgatvamiṣyate | buddhatvaṃ hi mṛtadagdhābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ bhavati mantriṇāṃ || 16 ||
prāṇāpānakṣayenātra dvādaśāṅgakṣayo bhavet | phalahetunirodhena ko buddho na bhaviṣyati || 17 ||
prāṇiṇāṃ prāṇasaṃcāro yāvattāvat punarbhavaḥ | vinaṣṭe prāṇasaṃcāre maraṇaṃ na punarbhavaḥ || 18 ||

* oṃ [a]kāro mukhaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ adyānutpannatvāditi |
atrākāraśabdenānāhatadhvaniḥ |
akāraḥ sarvavarṇāgro mahārthaparamākṣaraḥ | mahāprāṇo hyanutpādo vāgudāravivarjitaḥ || 19 ||
ityādinā veditavyo māyājāle | sarvaḥ sarvajñaḥ |
ātmavitparavit sarvaḥ sarvāyo hyagrapudgalaḥ | lokopamāmatikrānto jñeyojñānādhipaḥ paraḥ || 20 ||
ityādinā sarvajñasya mantraḥ sarvasattvabhūtaṃ vākyamiti nītārthaḥ | pṛthvyādīṣu bhūteṣu jātā bhautikāḥ paṃcaskandharūpadharmiṇaḥ teṣāṃ mantraḥ paṃcaskandhātmakaḥ paṃcākṣaramiti | oṃkāreṇa teṣāṃ rūpaskandhaṃ kāyavajram | āḥkāreṇa saṃjñāskandhaṃ vāgvajram | hūṃkāreṇa vijñānaskandhaṃ cittavajraḥ | svākāreṇa vedanāskandhaḥ | hākāreṇa saṃskāraskandhaḥ | teṣāṃ balisamarpaṇam | ante hūṃkāratrayeṇa phaṭkāradvayena visarjanamiti | evaṃ oṃkāreṇa śodhanam | āḥkāreṇa boddhanam | hūṃkāreṇa pradīpanam | svāhākāreṇāmṛtīkaraṇam | hākāreṇāvāhanam | hūṃkāratrayeṇa samarpaṇaṃ | phaṭkāradvayena visarjanam | vāmahastena śodhanam | dakṣiṇahastena bodhanam | aṃjalināpihitasya pradīpanam | garuḍamudrayā'mṛtīkaraṇam | trailokyavijayamudrayāvāhanam | vajramudrayā samarpaṇam | hastaspṛṣṭena chottikātrayeṇa visarjanamiti | evaṃ mudrābandhaṃ tantrāntareṇa jñeyam | evaṃ tathāgatānāṃ bījāni yathāsaṃkhyam | tadyathā vuṃkāreṇa vairācanaḥ śirasi | aṃkāreṇa ratnasaṃbhavo nābhyām | jrīṃkāreṇāmitābhaḥ kaṇṭhe | khaṃkāreṇāmogho guhye | hūṃkāreṇākṣobhyo hṛdaye | evaṃ picūvajrasya śarīre nyāsaṃ kṛtvā'nyeṣāmapi vajraḍākānāmiti niyamaḥ |
tataḥ ṣoḍaśabhujasya mantraḥ |
* oṃ deva picūvajra hūṃ [3] phaṭ svāhā |
atra nītārthaḥ | oṃkāreṇa devatā-āsanaṃ yathā tathā mantrādyakṣareṇa devatāniṣpattiḥ | śeṣabījairaṅganyāsaḥ cakṣurādeḥ yathākrameṇa hūṃkāratrayeṇa jñānasatvākarṣaṇam | phaṭkāreṇa nirodhanam | svākāreṇa toṣaṇam | hākāreṇa samarasīkaraṇam | iti hevajrasya hṛdayam | evaṃ
* sarvamantrapadāḥ oṃkārādi svāhāntāḥ hūṃphaṭkārāntavidarbhitā madhya iti niyamaḥ ||
sarvatra pūrvavat |
evaṃ caturbhujasya oṃ jvalajvalabhyo hūṃ [3] phaṭ svāhā evaṃ dvibhujasya oṃ trailokyākṣepa hūṃ [3] phaṭ svāhā | * oṃ kiṭikiṭi-vajra hūṃ [3] phaṭsvāhā | iti ṣaḍbhujasya |
atra mantroddhārapaṭale huṃkāra phaṭkāropadeśato jñeyāḥ |
sarveṣāṃ kāyavākcittādhiṣṭhānamantraḥ | [oṃ āḥ hūṃ]
oṃkāreṇa kāyādhiṣṭhānaṃ vairocana candramaṇḍale | āḥkāreṇa vāgadhiṣṭhānamamitābhaḥ sūrye | hūṃkāreṇa cittādhiṣṭhānaṃ akṣobhyo hṛdaye rāhūmaṇḍala iti | atra neyārthena nairātmādīnām | svarāmantroddhārarthamucyate | aāiīuūṛṝḷḹeaioauämiti | nītārthena punaḥ pratyāhārapāṭhena gṛhyate | aiuṛḷka | a e ar o al ca ha ya ra va la ṭa iti bījāni śuklapakṣe candrakalānāṃ na bālapāṭhanyāyena neyārthena bhagavatoktānīti mūlatantre niyamaḥ |
* evaṃ purakṣobhamantraḥ oṃ akacaṭatapayaśasvāhā |
iti neyārthena | nītārtheno akuhavisarjanīyā kaṇṭhyāḥ | icūyaśāstālavyāḥ | ṛṭuraṣā mūrdhanyāḥ | upūpadhmānīyā oṣṭhayāḥ | ḷtulasā dantyāḥ iti | a ā ha hākārāditaḥ | ṅañaṇamanajña svāhā iti purakṣobhamantraḥ | mantroddhārapaṭale gurupadeśato jñeyam | mūlatantre nītārthenopadeśaḥ | āleḥ triṃśanmuhūrtāni candrakalābhedena pratidinaṃ sūryasya ṣaṣṭhivyaṃjanāni daṇḍabhedena japtavyāni | akacaṭatapayasaśabdenālikāli nītārthenoktaḥ ālikālijapena trailokyaṃ kṣobhayet mantrī lakṣajāpena | kiṃ puramekamātramiti | ādi-kādi ucyate | tadyathā a ā i ī ṛ ṝ u ū ḷ ḹ a ā e ai ar ār o au al āl ha hā ya yā ra rā va vā la lā iti sṛṣṭikrameṇālijapaḥ svāsapraveśena | svāsanirgameṇa kāliḥ | ka kā kha khā ga gā gha ghā ṅa ṅā | ca cā cha chā ja jā jha jhā ña ñā | ṭa ṭā ṭha ṭhā ḍa ḍā ḍha ḍhā ṇa ṇā | pa pā pha phā ba bā bha bhā ma mā | ta tā tha thā da dā dha dhā na nā śa śā jña jñā ṣa ṣā sa sā kṣa kṣā iti | ādau oṃkāraḥ kṣobhaṇe | ākṛṣṭāvante vauṣaṭ deyaḥ | evaṃ purakṣobhamantraḥ | ekadevatādhyānena raktapuṣpajapena homena ca | iti vakṣyamāṇena vaktavyam |
evaṃ kurukullāmantramucyate | oṃkāreṇādhāraḥ kāyaniṣpattiḥ | hrīṃkāreṇa vāg-niṣpattiḥ | bāhyakule kurukullā amitābhamudritā | lalāṭe oṃ jihvāyāṃ hrīḥ kaṇṭhe ku hṛdaye ru nābhyāṃ ku guhye lle iti aṃganyāsaḥ | ucchvāsaṃ pūrayitvā japellakṣamekam | niśvāsakāle'kṣasūtraṃ na cālayediti kurukullāmantraḥ |
idānīṃ rakṣā-mantrasya nītārthaṃ ucyate | oṃkāreṇa mṛdvāsanaṃ kathayati | sugandhabhūmisthānamapi manoramacandravat | rakārākṣareṇāgrataḥ sūryamaṇḍalam | kṣakāreṇa viśvavajram | tenādhaürdhvaṃ sarvadikṣudaśāracakraṃ kṛtvā tato madhye vajrahūṃkāraṃ krodharājendram | pūrvāre yamāntakaḥ | dakṣiṇāre prajñāntakaḥ | paścimāre padmāntakaḥ | uttarāre vighnāntakaḥ | āgneyāṃ acalaḥ | naiṛtye ṭarkkiḥ | vāyavye nīladaṇḍaḥ aiśānye mahābalaḥ | udhvāre uṣṇīṣaḥ | adhasi śumbharāja iti | tataḥ dvitīyoccāraṇam | rakāreṇa sūryamaṇḍalam | kṣakāreṇa viśvavajram | tenaika lolibhūtena vajraprākāratrayam | hūṃkāratrayeṇa vajrabhūmiṃ kūṭāgāraṃ vajrapadmāsanaṃ ceti | phaṭkāreṇa duṣṭakīlanaṃ svākāreṇa buddhabodhisatvānāṃ prabodhanam | hākāreṇa sakalapūjādikaṃ pāpadeśanādikāmuktaṃ bhavatīti nītārtho'sya mantrasya |
idānīṃ mūlatantroktāni caturviṃśatiḥ karmasādhanāni mantrapadānyucyate | atra laghutantre anuloma-vilomena sarvaṃ gopitaṃ duṣṭācāryāṇāṃ sadgurupāraṃparyakrameṇa jñātavyaṃ na pustakapāṭhena | aparatantrāntaraṃ dṛṣṭvā yad udghaṭate (?) bahutantrasaṃgataṃ tadvākya grāhyaṃ bhagavato na śraddhājaḍatvena | tathā bhagavatoktaṃ ādau kalyāṇaṃ madhye kalyāṇaṃ paryavasāne kalyāṇaṃ mama vākyam | evaṃ na punarādau kalyāṇaṃ madhye kalyāṇaṃ ādau madhye ante kalyāṇam | tathā bālajanaiḥ parikalpitam | ādau savikalpabhāvanā madhye dvindriyasukhabhāvanā ante nirvikalpakaśūnyabhāvanā mahāsukhabhāvanā iti duṣṭavākyam |
hetunā sadṛśāṃ tajjaṃ phalaṃ sarvatra dṛśyate | na hi kodravabījebhyaḥ śālidhānyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 21 ||
vikalpe bījasaṃbhūtaṃ savikalpaphalaṃ bhavet | nirvikalpasamutpannaṃ nirvikalpaphalaṃ bhavet || 22 ||
ato hetorādau kalyāṇaṃ madhye kalyāṇaṃ paryavasāne kalyāṇam |
yathā bījaṃ tathā vṛkṣo yathā vṛkṣastathā phalam | dṛśyate sarvaloke'smin pratītyotpādameva tat || 23 ||
yo'nyajātiḥ bhavet mantraḥ so'nya karma na sādhakaḥ | na sūryaḥ kutracilloke dāghopaśamakārakaḥ || 24 ||
mūlatantre yathā proktaṃ hevajreṇa mama sphuṭam | laghutantre tadeva tāvannirdeśāducyate mayā || 25 ||
bhūbījair stambhanaṃ kuryāt mohanaṃ kīlanaṃ tathā | toyabījaiḥ sadā śānti pauṣṭikaṃ vaśyaṃ nirviṣaṃ tathā ||
tejobījaiḥ mahākṛṣṭi vaśyaṃ kṣobhaṃ ca sarvathā | vidveṣoccāṭaṇaṃ vātairviṣasaṃkramaṇaṃ tathā || 27 ||
śūnyabījairviṣacchedaṃ māraṇaṃ jīvanaṃ tathā | jīvanotthāpanānandaṃ jñānabījaiḥ prasādhitam || 28 ||
mūkatvaṃ badhiratvaṃ ṣaṇḍhikaraṇameva ca | cittavākkāyabījaiśca kuryāt mantrī yathākramam || 29 ||
bhūtoyāgnimarutśūnyaṃ jñānamaṇḍalayogataḥ | stambhanādīni karmāṇi sādhayet sādhakottamaḥ || 30 ||
ṣaṇḍhikaraṇaṃ mūkatvaṃ cāndhatvaṃ prāṇārodhanam | badhiratvaṃ manotmādaṃ pūrvabījaistu prasādhitam || 31 ||
girigahvarakuñjeṣu mahodaḍhitaṭe tathā | smaśāneśvādisiddhau ca eṣu sthāneṣu kāryet || 32 ||
mantrajāpaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ homaṃ maṇḍalavartanam | pratikarmānurūpena nānyathā siddhidā bhavet || 33 ||
anyasthāne narastriṇāṃ sādhitā mantradevatā | devatā kurute karmaṃ tantra mantra pracoditā || 34 ||
tasmānnāmañca kāyañca japyaṃ bhāvyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ | mūlamantrau bhavetkāyo hṛdayākhyo vāksvarūpavān || 35 ||
upahṛdayaṃ evaṃ syāt cittamantramudāhṛtam | jñānabījasiti khyātaṃ jñānamantraḥ sa ucyate || 36 ||
bījeṣu upahṛdayañcaiva hṛdayaṃ mūlamantraḥ | jñānaṃ cittavākkāyaṃ bhāvyaṃ japyaṃ yathākramāt || 37 ||
japyaṃ pūjyaṃ prayatnena yāvat bhavet siddhidam | anyathā vidhihīnasya mantrasiddhirbhavenna ca || 38 ||
śraddhayāsya gṛhitasya kāyakleśantu kevalam | yaralavāstu ye vargā vāyutejodharāmbujāḥ || 39 ||
pūrvadakṣiṇavāruṇye uttareṣu viyojayet | dīrghāvahnau ca naiṛtye marut īśvarakramāt || 40 ||
urdhve'dhasi hahādeyāḥ madhye aṃ aḥ prapūjayet | maṇḍalaṃ sarvabuddhānāṃ kārayet gurukāgrataḥ || 41 ||
saddharma-paṭhanārthaṃ hi anyat paṃcajinātmakam | vāyumaṇḍaladharme vṛttaṃ pūrvavidehakam || 42 ||
tejomaṇḍaladharmeṇa jambudvīpaṃ trikoṇakam | caturasrāparagodānī pṛthivīmaṇḍalalakṣaṇā || 43 ||
toyamaṇḍaladharmeṇārdhacandrottarakuruḥ | brahmāṇḍaṃ śūnyarūpeṇa candramaṇḍalalakṣaṇam || 44 ||
adhasi jñānarūpeṇa kālāgniḥ sūryamaṇḍalam | madhyebinduvisargaḥ syādadhaürdhvandevaparvataḥ || 45 ||
evaṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā tato mantrādikaṃ pūjayet || rajo maṇḍalavat kuryādaparaṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhuvi | ṣaṣṭhaskandhadhāturūpādyā ṣaḍtriṃśan pūjayetsadā || 46 ||
pṛthvīḥ salilaṃ vahniḥ vāyuḥ śukraṃ rajastathā | ṣaḍdhātuka iha khyāto rūpaskandhaḥ śarīriṇām || 47 ||
kaṇṭhatālavya-mūrdhanya-oṣṭhya-dantānunāsikam | saṃjñāpi ṣaḍvidhākhyātā bhāvābhāvārthasūcakī || 48 ||
nayanaśravaṇaghrāṇajihvākāyamanendriyair | vijñānaskandha ākhyātaḥ ṣaḍvidhaḥ cakṣurādinā || 49 ||
evaṃ rūpasya śabdasya gandhasya ca rasasya ca | sparśasya dharmadhātośca vijñānād vedanā smṛtāḥ || 50 ||
evaṃ ṣaḍindriyadvārairvijñānānāṃ pravartakaḥ | saṃskāraḥ ṣaḍvidhaḥ prokto viṣayeṣu pravartakaḥ || 51 ||
prāṇāpānayornityaṃ padmanāḍīṣu vāhakaḥ | urdhvādhastriṣu mārgeṣu jñānaskandho'pi ṣaḍvidhaḥ || 52 ||
ṣaḍtriṃśadbhirmahācittaṃ saptatriṃśatimaṃ param | dhātubhirveṣṭitaṃ yogī pūjayedādikādibhiḥ || 53 ||
ādikādisvabhāvena te dvāsaptatidhātavaḥ | ṣaṭvargakād ye vargā hrasvadīrghaprabhedataḥ || 54 ||
dvāsaptatisaṃkhyātāḥ svarāḥ ṣaḍtriṃśadeva te | ādikādi samāyuktairakṣasūtraṃ pragīyate || 55 ||
aṣṭottaraśatairvarṇairmantrajapāya yoginām | ṣaṭtriṃśadvyaṃjanairhrasvaiḥ svarairaṣṭādaśeryutam || 56 ||
aṣṭottaraśatārdhaiḥ tadakṣasūtraṃ pragīyate | nakṣatrapadabhedena tṛtīyaṃ parigīyate || 57 ||
nakṣatrārdhaprayogeṇa caturthaṃ tadvadeva hi | ṣaṭtriṃśat svarabhedena paṃcamaḥ parigīyate || 58 ||
nakṣatrabhogabhedena ṣaṣṭhamaḥ parigīyate | aṣṭādaśasvarabhedena saptamaṃ parigīyate || 59 ||
punarvyañjanabhedena ṣaṭtriṃśadbhistathāṣṭamaḥ | evamaṣṭavidhā proktaṃ akṣasūtraṃ tapasvinām || 60 ||
sphaṭikāṣṭadaśairekaṃ śāntikaṃ kārayed vratī | mauktikaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadbhiḥ svarābhyāṃ pauṣṭike nṛṇāṃ || 61 ||
saptāviṃśadbhiḥ nakṣatrairnṛdantairmāraṇaṃ smṛtam | tata dviguṇaṃ kharadantaiḥ syādvidveṣoccāṭane'pi ca || 62 ||
ṣaṭtriṃśadvyaṃjanaiḥ śuddhaṃ vaśyādyaṃ putrajīvakaiḥ | svaravyaṃjanasaṃmiśraiḥ padmākhyaiḥ caturontaraiḥ || 63 ||
paṃcāśadbhirmahākṛṣṭyā athavā candanabījakaiḥ | nakṣātrārddhapadairanyatra riṣṭakairmohane smṛtam || 64 ||
svaravyaṃjanapadaiḥ śuddhaṃ rudrākṣaṃ stambhane smṛtam | evamaṣṭavidhaṃ proktaṃ śuddhavaiśuddhakarmāṇi || 65 ||
miśrairnānāvidhairbījairmaṇibhirvā'tra kāraṇāt | dhātuvarṇeṣu bhedena yathālabdhaṃ tathā kuru || 66 ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi yogināṃ maṃtralakṣaṇam | yena siddhikaraṃ śīghraṃ mantraṃ bhavati kuloditam || 67 ||
akuhakṣaśca ye kaṇṭhayāḥ svaravyaṃjanalakṣaṇāḥ | ākāśadhātusaṃbhūtāḥ hakārajñapakena te || 68 ||
icuyaśāśca tālavyāḥ svaravyaṃjanalakṣaṇāḥ | vāyudhātusaṃbhūtāḥ yakārajñapakena te || 69 ||
ṛṭuraśāśca mūrdhanyāḥ svaravyaṃjanalakṣaṇāḥ | tejodhātusamudbhūtā rakārajñapakena te || 70 ||
upupadhmaśca ye oṣṭhyāḥ svaravyaṃjanalakṣaṇāḥ | toyadhātusamudbhūtāḥ vakārajñapakena te || 71 ||
ḷtulasā ye dantyāḥ svaravyaṃjanalakṣaṇāḥ | pṛthvīdhātusamudbhūtā lakārajñapakena te || 72 ||
anusvāro visargaśca svaravyaṃjanavarjitaḥ | jñānadhātusaṃbhūtaḥ evaṃ ṣaṭdhātukaṃ kulam || 73 ||
bhūtoyahutabhūkvāyu śukraṃ caiva rajaḥ bhūtam | ṣaṭdhātuka iha khyāto mahāpuruṣapudgalaḥ || 74 ||
janakaḥ sarvamantrāṇāṃ ādikādyātmakaḥ prabhuḥ | skandhadhātumantrātmā pratyāhāreṇa śaṃkaraḥ || 75 ||
deśayet sarvasiddhyarthaṃ mantrasiddho tameva ca | sarvajño'pi tathā mantrānna bālapaṭhanakramaiḥ || 76 ||
miśrā ye kaṇṭhatālavyāḥ kaṇṭhyoṣṭhyavyaṃjanasvarāḥ | dvisthānīyāśca ye cānye śuddhāḥ prakṛtijā na te || 77 ||
ekasthāne tu kaṇṭhādye śuddhāḥ prakṛtijāḥ svarāḥ | uccāritaḥ mahāmantro dvisthānoccāraṇānna saḥ || 78 ||
akārasvarasaṃyuktaṃ svasthānaṃ na jahāti yat | prakṛtyā pariśuddhaṃ tad vyaṃjanaṃ visargabindukam || 79 ||
ikādisvarairyuktaṃ dvisthāne yat pravartate | na tat prakṛtijaṃ śuddhaṃ vyaṃjanaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet || 80 ||
māhendramaṇḍalaṃ pītaṃ lakārākṣarasaṃbhavam | vāruṇamaṇḍalaṃ śuklaṃ vakārākṣarasaṃbhavam || 81 ||
agneyamaṇḍalaṃ raktaṃ rephākṣarasamudbhavam | vāyavyamaṇḍalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yakārākṣarasamudbhavam || 82 ||
ākāśamaṇḍalaṃ śyāmaṃ hakārākṣarasamudbhavam | visargabindusaṃbhūtaṃ jñānākhyaṃ sarvavarṇajam || 83 ||
evaṃ ta-vargajaṃ pītaṃ ḷkārasvarasaṃbhavam | śuklaṃ pa-vargajaṃ proktaṃ ukārasvarasaṃbhavam || 84 ||
raktaṃ ṭa-varga-samudbhūtaṃ ṛkārasvarasaṃbhavam | kṛṣṇaṃ ca-vargajaṃ proktaṃ ikārasvarasaṃbhavam || 85 ||
śyāmaṃ ka-vargajaṃ proktaṃ akārasvarasaṃbhavam | evaṃ sakārasaṃbhūtaṃ pītamalkārasaṃbhavam || 86 ||
śuklaṃ yakārasaṃbhūtaṃ oṃkāraguṇasaṃbhavam | raktaṃ ṣakārasaṃbhūtaṃ ekāraguṇasaṃbhavam || 87 ||
kṛṣṇaṃ śakārasaṃbhūtaṃ ekāraguṇasaṃbhavam | śyāmaṃ kṣakārasaṃbhūtaṃ akāraguṇasaṃbhavam || 88 ||
aiṛulgityete śuddhāḥ prakṛtijāḥ svarāḥ | a-e-ar-o-al caite dvidhā prakṛtijāguṇāḥ || 89 ||
hayaravalatityete yaṇādeśādvidhā tathā | gauṇamukhyadvayormadhye pramukhāḥ maṇḍalanāyakāḥ || 90 ||
bhūyaḥ pratyekavargasya prakṛtiḥ paṃcavidhā smṛtā | ṅañaṇamananityete śūnyadhātusamudbhavāḥ || 91 ||
ghajhaḍhadha[bha]dhidhyete vāyudhātusamudbhavāḥ | gajaḍabadadityete tejodhātu samudbhavāḥ || 92 ||
khachahaṭhaphathathityete toyadhātu samudbhavāḥ | kacaṭatapatityete pṛthivīdhātu samudbhavāḥ || 93 ||
ṣaṭkulaṃ vargabhedena pra[kṛ]termukhyabhedataḥ | pratyekākṣarabhedena kulaṃ paṃcavidhaṃ bhavet || 94 ||
pṛthivīpucchaṃ yathā pītaṃ rūpaṃ kāyendriyaṃ tathā | toyaṃ candraṃ ya[thā] śuklaṃ saṃjñā jihvendriyaṃ tathā || 95 ||
tejasūryā yathā rakte vedanā cakṣureva te | vāyuḥ rāhuḥ yathā kṛṣṇaḥ saṃskāro nāsikā tathā || 96 ||
yathā ākāśaṃ dhruvaṃ śyāmaṃ vijñānaṃ śravaṇaṃ tathā | jñānāgastiryathā nīlaṃ tathā jñānaṃ manaḥ smṛtam || 97 ||
evaṃ gandhaśca varṇaśca rasaśca sparśameva ca | śabdaśca dharmadhātuśca ṣaṭdhātukaṃ kulaṃ kramāt || 98 ||
evaṃ pāyustathāpādaśca pāṇivāgindriyaṃ tathā | bhago divyendriyaṃ caiva pṛthvyādi kulodbhavam || 99 ||
evamālāpamādānaṃ gatirviṭsrāva eva ca | śukracyutiḥ kriyā etāḥ pṛthvyādikulodbhavāḥ || 100 ||
evaṃ ṣaḍdhātavaḥ proktāḥ ṣaṭskandhā indriyāṇi ca | ṣaḍviṣayāḥ karmendriyāṇyevaṃ ṣaṣṭhākarmendriyakriyā || 101 ||
ṣaṭskandhabhedena ṣaṭtriṃśaditi dhātavaḥ | saptatriṃśatidhā prajñā sarve dharmaikaśūnyatā || 102 ||
dhātavo bāhyadehe ca yathā dehe tathā pare | stambhanaṃ śuddhamedinyo śuddhatoyena śāntikam || 103 ||
śuddhena tejasā vaśyaṃ vidveṣaṃ śuddhavāyunā | jīvanaṃ śuddhaṃ śūnyena śuddhajñānena māraṇaṃ || 104 ||
ṣaṭkarmāṇīti śuddhāni vimiśrāṇyaparāni ca | pṛthivītoyavimiśreṇa pauṣṭikaṃ sarvadehinām || 105 ||
vāyutejovimiśreṇa kampanaṃ bhavati dehinām | vāyutoyavimiśreṇākarṣaṇaṃ bhavati dehinām || 106 ||
pṛthivīśūnyavimiśreṇa pātanaṃ bhavati dehinām | pṛthivī jñānavimiśreṇa patitotthāpanaṃ punaḥ || 107 ||
toyatejavimiśreṇa drāvaṇaṃ strīnṛṇāṃ smṛtam | pṛthivīvāyuvimiśreṇa mohanaṃ kīlanaṃ bhavet || 108 ||
śūnyatoyavimiśreṇa satvasyāpyāyanaṃ bhavet | śūnyajñānavimiśreṇa pratyujjīvanaṃ bhavet || 109 ||
tejabhūmivimiśreṇa saṃtāpaṃ sarvadehinām | tejaśūnyavimiśreṇa jvaro bhavati dehinām || 110 ||
tejojñānavimiśreṇa stobho bhavati dehinām | vāyuśūnyavimiśreṇa viśvamuccāṭayed dhruvam || 111 ||
vāyujñānavimiśreṇa trailokyaṃ bandhayet kṣaṇāt | śūnyajñānavimiśreṇa utpādaḥ sarvadehinām || 112 ||
jñānaikaṃ sarvakarmāṇi kurute jñānavādinām | na jāpo nākṣasūtrāṇi na homo na mantrapūjanaṃ || dhyānamātreṇa siddhayante sarvakarmāṇi yoginām || 113 ||
evaṃ trikulamantrāścatuḥ paṃcakulāśca ye | kurvantyanantakarmāṇi vidhinā dhātusvabhāvataḥ || 114 ||
ityevaṃ ṣaṭkulamantrāḥ śuddhā anyonyamiśritāḥ | te'saṃkhyā mahāsattva devatāsiddhisādhane || 115 ||
mantrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye paṃcadhātusvabhāvataḥ | śatrumitramudāsyaṃ ca satvārthāya nigadyate || 116 ||
akuhajñaśca ye kaṇṭhyāḥ svaravyaṃjanalakṣaṇāḥ | śūnyavāyvādimantrāṇāṃ mitrarthena sadāsthitaḥ || 117 ||
icuyaśāśca tālavyāḥ svaravyaṃjanalakṣaṇāḥ | vāyudhātusamudbhūtāḥ śatravaḥ toyajanminā || 118 ||
ṛṭuraṣāstu mūrdhanyāḥ svaravyaṃjanalakṣaṇāḥ | tejodhātusamudbhūtāḥ śatravo bhūmijanmiṇām || 119 ||
upuvaśāśca ye cauṣṭhayāḥ svaravyaṃjanalakṣaṇāḥ | toyadhātusamudbhūtāḥ śatravo vahnijanminām || 120 ||
ḷtulasāśca dantyāḥ ye svaravyaṃjanalakṣaṇāḥ | pṛthivīdhātusamudbhūtā śatravo vāyujanminām || 121 ||
vāyormitraṃ sadā śūnyaṃ udāsya vāryaśaktitaḥ | agnermitraṃ sadā vāyuḥ udāsya pṛthvyāśaktitaḥ || 122 ||
pṛthvyā udakaṃ mitraṃ ca udāsya vāyureva ca | toyasya medinī mitramudāsyo'gniśaktitaḥ || 123 ||
praṇavaṃ varjayitvā tu mantrasyādyakṣaraṃ kulam | cittaṃ tadeva mantrāṇāṃ bimbaniṣpatterkāraṇam || 124 ||
anye vyaṃjanasaṃyuktaṃ mantrasyādyakṣarambhavet | tadā pūrvataryo grāhyaḥ prathamoccārahetutaḥ || 125 ||
svaravyaṃjanabhedena tadeva dvaividhaṃ bhavet | prāṇasya śatrumitrañca kāyasyāpi nigadyate || 126 ||
prāṇasya śatravo mitraṃ udāsyā vā svarāḥ smṛtāḥ | kāyasya śatravo mitraṃ udāsyāḥ vyaṃjanāḥ smṛtāḥ || 127 ||
svaraśatru haret prāṇaṃ sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥ | rogādyaṃ kurute kāye śatruvyaṃjanalakṣaṇaḥ || 128 ||
ekavarge'pi paṃca kādyāvyaṃjanadharmiṇaḥ | pṛthvyādi kulaṃ teṣāṃ jñātavyaṃ mantrasādhane || 129 ||
ṅañamaṇananityete mitratve nāpare sthitāḥ | ghajhaḍhabhadhādhityete śatravaḥ toyajanminām || 130 ||
gajaḍabadadityete śatravo bhūmījanminām | khachaṭhaphathathityete śatravo vāyujanminām || 131 ||
evaṃ pūrvavat jñeyo mitrodāsyāḥ parasparam | mantrādau saṃsthitā varṇāḥ svavargeṣu pareṣu vā || 132 ||
sādhakānāṃ dvidhā varṇā janmajo nāmajo bhavet | dvidhā so'pi pare jñeyo vyaṃjanasvaralakṣaṇaḥ || 133 ||
janmakāle'pi yallagnaṃ paṃcadaṇḍātmakaṃ bhavet | makārādyaṃ narastrīṇāṃ vyaṃjanaṃ tena śodhayet || 134 ||
makare kādayaḥ paṃcadaṇḍabhedena śodhayet | kumbhe'pi ṅādayaḥ paṃcaśūnyādikramabhedataḥ || 135 ||
mīne'pi cādayaḥ paṃcameṣe'pi ñādayaḥ kramāt | vṛṣabhe dādayaḥ paṃcamithuneṣu ṇādayaḥ tathā || 136 ||
pādayaḥ karkaṭalagne ca siṃhalagne'pi mādayaḥ | kanyāyāṃ tādayaḥ paṃcatulāyāṃ nādayaḥ tathā || 137 ||
vṛścike sādayaḥ paṃcadhanuṣiṃ kādayaḥ smṛtāḥ | saṃhārasṛṣṭibhedena ṣaṣṭivarṇādivāniśam || 138 ||
dakṣiṇe vāmasaṃcāre paṃcamaṇḍalavāhakāḥ | ṛtupakṣaprabhedena yathā bāhye tathā tanau || 139 ||
svarāścatuḥ kalāmadhye triṃśadbhedairviśodhayet | śuklapratipadārabhya amāntāḥ triṃśaddevatāḥ || 140 ||
aiuṛḷgityete pratipadādyā yathākramam | a-e-ar-o-al-vityete ṣaṣṭyādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 141 ||
hayaravalahityete ekādaśyādayaḥ smṛtāḥ | lādyāpañcavilomena kṛṣṇapratipadādayaḥ smṛtāḥ || 142 ||
ālākārādayaḥ paṃca ṣaṣṭhayādyaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣataḥ | ḷkārādyāśca ye paṃca ekādaśyādayaḥ svarāḥ || 143 ||
pūrṇānte bindukaḥ proktaḥ amānte ca visarjanī | te muhūrtaprabhe[de]na candrasya pratikalāḥ smṛtāḥ || 144 ||
yaḥ svaro nāyako yasyāṃ kalāyāmudayaṃ vrajet | muhūrte prathame so'sya jātakasya svaro bhavet || 145 ||
tata dvitīyo dvitīyena eva sarve yathākramam | triṃśatmuhūrtabhedena janmanaḥ svara ucyate || 146 ||
prāṇakṣayo mahāvyādhiḥ sādhakānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ | śabdena mantrapūrveṇa svarena vyaṃjanena vai || 147 ||
janmasvarāparijñānāt vyaṃjanasyāprabodhataḥ | nāmādisvaro grāhyo vyaṃjanaṃ hyanyaḥ(?) pūrvakaḥ || 148 ||
mantrādivyaṃjanānāṃ vā svarāṇāṃ sādhanāya ca | karmārthaṃ ṣaṭvidhaṃ proktaṃ sevājāpaṃ prakurvataḥ || 149 ||
prathamaṃ tāḍanaṃ kuryāt āveśaṃ dāhanaṃ tataḥ | āpyāyanaṃ tato mantrī poṣaṇaṃ tataḥ || 150 ||
savisargena śūnyena ākrānto mantrapūrvakaḥ | mūrcchāvasthāmavāpnoti mantrarājena tāḍitaḥ || 151 ||
lakṣajapena mantrasya mūrcchitā sā tu devatā | ahaṃkāraṃ parityaktā sādhakasya vaśī bhavet || 152 ||
evaṃ sā vāyunākrāntā ādisaṃyāti yoginam | dahyate vahninākrāntā toyenāpyāyate tataḥ || 153 ||
pṛthivīmūrdhnisthitā puṣṭijaptā gacchati devatā | mūrdhni candrakalākrānto toṣitā varadā bhavet || 154 ||
evaṃ ṣaṭlakṣajāpena pūrvasevā nigadyate | mūlatantreṣu sarveṣu sugateneṣṭasiddhaye || 155 ||
phaṭkāra hūṃ tathā vauṣaṭ namaḥ svāhā vaṣaṭastathā | ṣaṭkarmāṇi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ mantrānte kārayed vratī || 156 ||
ādau vairocanaṃ datvā punarjāpaṃ samārabhet | koṭijapaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā homaṃ kuryāt daśāṃsikam || 157 ||
tantroktavidhinā sarvaṃ tataḥ siddhyati devatā | varaṃ dadāti sā siddhāṃ mantriṇāṃ prārthitaṃ ca yat || 158 ||
anya jātiḥ kriyā cānyo kālo mantrīkulaṃ kulī | anyasthānadiśādhāraṃ niśphalaṃ sarvakarmeṣu || 159 ||
pustakāt paṭhitairmantraiḥ saṃpradāyavivarjitaiḥ | sādhanaṃ ye prakurvanti te kliśyanti narā bhuvi || 160 ||
kinnāma sampradāyaṃ taṃ pustakādyadi labhyate | yathā likhitapāṭhena neyārthena prakāśitam || 161 ||
ākāśaṃ bhoktumicchanti mantrasadbhāvavarjitāḥ | pustakāt paṭhitairmantrairdevādīnāṃ ca sādhakāḥ || 162 ||
svacittadṛḍhavīryena mantrajāpena vā bhavet | īpsitā laukikīsiddhiḥ sādhakānāṃ parārthināṃ || 163 ||
mantrajapaistathā homaiḥ snāna pūjāvidhikramaiḥ | kriyāhīnā na siddhayanti yathābhūtamidaṃ vacaḥ || 164 ||
śāstṛṇāṃ bodhisattvānāṃ devatādeśa saṃprati | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena tadeva gṛhyate budhaiḥ || 165 ||
ityādi mūlatantre'nyenopāyena mantrasādhanamuktaṃ stambhanādikarmasādhanārtham | asmin laghutantre sandhyābhāṣāntareṇārthānugamaḥ | sa evocyate |

hūṃkāreṇa pṛthivī sādhanīyā stambhanaṃ kuryāt |
* oṃ āṃ svāhā vaśyamiti |
ākāreṇa tejodhātu sādhanīyo tathā vaśyaṃ karttavyam |
* oṃ khaṃ svāhā uccāṭaṇamiti |
khaṃkāreṇa vāyudhātuḥ sādhanīya tathoccāṭaṇaṃ karttavyam |
* oṃ jṛṃ svāhā vidveṣamiti |
[jṛṃkāreṇa] vāyutejovimiśradhātuḥ sādhanīyo tābhyāṃ vidveṣaḥ karttavyaḥ |
* oṃ buṃ svāhā abhicārukamiti |
būṃkāreṇa tejaüdaka sādhanīyau tābhyāmabhicārukaṃ kuryāt |
* oṃ hrīṃ svāhā ākarṣakamiti |
hrīṃkāreṇa vāyu-agni-ākāśadhātavaḥ sādhanīyāḥ tairākṛṣṭiḥ karttavyāḥ |
* oṃ ghūḥ svāhā māraṇamiti |
ghūḥkāreṇa vāyuudaka sādhanīyau tābhyāṃ māraṇaṃ ka[rtta]vyam | sandhyābhāṣe'yaṃ pravakṣyāmi |
pratyakṣamindriyāṇāṃ yat pratyakṣaṃ cittakalpitam | utpattikrame jñānaṃ buddhakaraṃ na tat || 166 ||
pratyakṣaṃ yogino yacca svasaṃvedanakaṃ tat | utpannakrame jñānaṃ buddhatvakaraṃ param || 167 ||
tadeva paṃcadhābhinnaṃ ādimadhyāvasānataḥ | dharmasaṃgrahe uktāni cakṣuṃṣi paṃcatāyinām || 168 ||
māṃsacakṣuḥ tato divyaṃ buddhacakṣustato bhavet | prajñācakṣuḥ tato bhūyāt jñānacakṣuśca paṃcamaḥ || 169 ||
māṃsacakṣurbhavedādau ādikarmikayoginām | divyaṃ cakṣustataḥ teṣāṃ devānāṃ tu yathā tathā || 170 ||
buddhacakṣurbhavettasmāt śrāvakāṇāṃ yathā tathā | tato jñānagamaṃ cakṣuḥ sugatānāṃ yathā tathā || 171 ||
prajñācakṣustato bodhisatvānāṃ hi yathā tathā | caturvidhaṃ cakṣuḥ jñānamasyāstīti tena saḥ || 172 ||
jñānījñānavibhāgena dvidhā [bhā]va pradarśitaḥ | tāyināṃ jñānacakṣuryat tat jñānīti nigadyate || 173 ||
anādinidhano buddho ādibuddho niranvayaḥ | jñānaikaśca vimalo jñānamūrtistathāgataḥ || 174 ||

daśadikkīlayitvā tu duṣṭān tat sārayet tataḥ | vajravahni samantācca visphurantaṃ vicintayet || 56 ||
duṣṭān palāyitān tena dahamānānitastataḥ |
atra laghutantre astavyastaṃ rakṣācakraṃ yogī tasyopari sthitvā ityādino bhāvayet | śraddhayā kīlaparyantaṃ rakṣācakraniyamaḥ catuḥ ślokairiti |
paramārthena tato bhāvyaṃ niḥsvabhāvaṃ bhavatrayam ||
abhāve bhāvanā bhāvo bhāvanā naiva bhāvanā | iti bhāvo na bhāvaḥ syāt bhāvanā nopalabhyate || 57 ||
prathamaṃ śūnyatābodhiṃ dvitīyaṃ bījasaṃgraham | tṛtīyaṃ bimbaniṣpatiḥ caturthaṃ nyāsamakṣaram ||
evaṃ rakṣācakraṃ yogatantrāntarasāreṇa kṛtvā mantrī tataḥ svahṛdaye hūṃkāraraśmibhirgaganata[la] paripūrya yathādhimukti gurubuddhabodhisattvasahitaṃ nabhasi bhaṭṭārakaṃ prabhuṃ vicintayet | aṣṭamātribhiḥ pariveṣṭitaṃ svaprajñāliṅgitaṃ tataḥ tān raśminnivarṇayitvā svahṛdaye praviśya hūṃkārādaṣṭadevīṃ niścārayet bhagavat pūjākaraṇāya | atrāpi vilomena gāthaikayā vispharanti svadehābhagaganamaṇḍalacchādakā |
saṃhāryānayet svahṛdaye yogī dveṣātmako bhavet | vyomni bhaṭṭārakaṃ dṛṣṭvā vajrajanyaṃ mahākṛpam || 58 ||
pūjayedaṣṭadevyabhiḥ sarvālaṅkāradhāribhiḥ | gauri mṛgalāṃcchanadharti cauri mārtaṇḍabhājanam || 59 ||
vetālī vārihastā ca bhaiṣajyadhartiṃ ghasmarim | pukkasī vajrahastā ca śabarī rasadharī tathā || 60 ||
caṇḍāli ḍamarukaṃ vādet ḍombi rāgena nirvṛttim | candraṃ śukraṃ rajaḥ sūryaḥ mūtraṃ vāri nigadyate || 61 ||
majjaṃ māṃsaṃ ca bhaiṣajyaṃ vajraṃ vairocanaṃ smṛtam | rasaṃ ṣaḍrasaḥ khyātaḥ gokṣādyaṃ ḍamarakaṃ balam || 62 ||
nṛtyañca madirāpānamityāṣṭau samayāḥ smṛtāḥ | ebhiḥ saṃpūjayet mantrī śaraṇaṃ ratnatrayaṃ vrajet || 63 ||
pāpānāṃ deśanā kuryāt puṇyānāṃ cānumodanā | niryātanā svakāyasya mārgāśrayeṇameva ca || 64 ||
bodhicittaṃ samutpadya tato buddhā vivarjayet | śūnyatālambanārthāya praṇidhānālambaṃ vicārayet || 65 ||
svabhāvābhāvataḥ śūnyamahetoranimittakam | atavyāt praṇihitaṃ naivaṃ abhisaṃskāravarjitam || 66 ||
utpādaṃ nirodhābhāvāt praṇidhānaṃ nirarthakam | na sattvo nāpi buddhatvaṃ dharmādharmā na tattvataḥ || 67 ||
yathā māyā tathā svapnaṃ gandharvanagaraṃ yathā | yathā sattvāstathā buddhā draṣṭavyāḥ tatvabhāvanaiḥ || 68 ||
yadvat pratiravastadvat buddhānāṃ dharmadeśanā | evaṃ vicārayitvā tu āsaṃsāra bhavasthitim || 69 ||
bodhisattvā prakurvanti sattvānugrahahetunā | māraṇaṃ ca samāpatti jñeyāvaraṇameva ca || 70 ||
na nirdagdha mahākleśairlavamātrañca rakṣitam | bodhisattvairmahāvīraiḥ sarvasattvakṛpālubhiḥ || 71 ||
buddhatvaṃ bodhisattvatvaṃ sarvameva vicārya ca | śūnyatālambanaṃ kuryāt mantrametadudāharaṇam || 72 ||
oṃ śūnyatāvajrasvabhāvātmako'haṃ ityuccārya praṇidhānaṃ tataḥ smaret | tena praṇidhānacittena devahaṃkāraṃ svacittena bhāvayet sa trijagat krīḍārtham | atra vakṣyamāṇa
maṇḍalacakraṃ dhyātvā śmaśānāṣṭakabhūṣitam | tanmadhye'ṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ sūryamaṇḍalakaṃ tataḥ || 73 ||
dharmadhātvātmakaṃ pretaṃ mārtaṇḍā paribhāvayet | dvātriṃśatsvarāścandre buddhalakṣaṇahetutaḥ || 74 ||
aśītyanuvyaṃjanāni arke hūṃkāraṃ tayoḥ | sa eva satvamityāhuḥ sahajānandasvabhāvakam || 75 ||
ādarśasamatājñānaṃ pratyavekṣaṇakramāt | teṣāmekamanuṣṭhānaṃ bimbaniṣpattireva ca || 76 ||
dharmadhātuṃ idaṃ proktaṃ paṃcamaṃ jñānamuttamam | paṃcākārābhisaṃbuddho hevajro dvibhujo bhavet || 77 ||
nīlāruṇābhavarṇena raktavaṇḍūkalocanam | kapālamuṇḍamālyabhiḥ akṣobhyaḥ kṛtaśekharam || 78 ||
cakrīkuṇḍalakaṇṭhī ca rucakaṃ cāpi mekhalām | paṃcabuddhaviśuddhā ca paṃcamudrā prakīrtitāḥ || 79 ||
